articleTitle: Music Instrument Recognition using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Advances in Science and Technology (ICAST)
abstract: Music plays a significant role in our daily lives for a vast majority of people worldwide. Various parameters can be used to classify music, including genre, performer, or composer. Automatic musical instrument recognition is crucial for complex tasks such as melody extraction, music information retrieval, and identifying dominant instruments from audio. Recognizing instruments automatically is particularly essential for organizing multiple tracks in an audio clip since manual recognition can be a tedious process. This is where automatic musical instrument recognition comes in handy. It involves detecting and categorizing active instruments, which is the focus of this research. To enhance musical instrument classification, we suggest employing a deep Convolutional Neural Network algorithm designed to efficiently identify musical instruments. Our algorithm includes convolutional layers, and we utilize the Mel spectrogram and Mel Frequency Cepstral Coefficient (MFCC) along with the Convolutional Neural Network to identify instruments present in the Medley Solos DB dataset. This dataset contains over 21,931 audio clips of eight instruments. We perform training based on the model described above, and our testing results show that our suggested method considerably recognizes instruments and achieves better accuracy than the existing approach.

articleTitle: A Comparison of Machine Learning Algorithms for Customer Churn Prediction
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Advances in Science and Technology (ICAST)
abstract: Today’s fiercely competitive business environment has given significant importance to customer churn, a term used for the loss of customers, which possesses a significant challenge to organizations across various industries. To mitigate revenue loss and sustain growth, companies are increasingly turning to machine learning (ML) algorithms for customer churn prediction. This review paper provides a concise examination of ML algorithms’ role in predicting customer churn, a pivotal concern for businesses seeking to sustain growth and profitability. The review begins by underlining the significance of customer churn in today’s competitive landscape, highlighting the impact of data-driven approaches in this context. The paper then explores various ML algorithms suitable for churn prediction and comparing the results to find out the most optimal algorithm for a few real-world scenarios, namely telecommunication, banking and ecommerce. The review found that Decision Tree Classification, Random Forest Classification, AdaBoost and XGBoost Classification algorithms were optimal for churn prediction. Additionally, the review covers the implementation of the findings in a churn prediction application.

articleTitle: Multi-Disease Prediction System Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Advances in Science and Technology (ICAST)
abstract: The proposed Multi-Disease Prediction System will be a web application for predicting common diseases like diabetes, cancer, and chronic conditions using machine learning. The goal will be to provide easy access to risk analysis and disease awareness through an interactive platform. The system will employ statistical models and deep neural networks trained on medical datasets to predict multiple diseases. Users can input their health data like symptoms and lab tests to get real-time predictions. Disease-specific models are developed using appropriate algorithms and saved via pickling. The malaria and pneumonia models leverage deep learning on imaging data. By making reliable disease prediction accessible the system enables users to get early insights into potential risks. It also provides information on disease causes and prevention to promote proactive health management. The aim is to develop an accurate and convenient application for data-driven disease screening without needing in person clinic visits. This could make personalized health analysis more accessible to the broader population. The models are continuously improved using the latest advancements in AI and ML predictive techniques.

articleTitle: Review of Deep Speech Recognizer using Transcriber
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Advances in Science and Technology (ICAST)
abstract: This research presents the development of a “Deep Speech Recognizer using Transcriber,” aimed at streamlining the process of capturing and converting live speech into text. The primary problem addressed by this system is the need for efficient and accurate transcription in various contexts, such as meetings, lectures, and interviews. The methodology employed in this project utilizes Jupyter widgets for user interaction, PyAudio for microphone audio capture, Vosk for speech recognition, and recasepunc for punctuation enhancement. Key findings of this research include the successful implementation of a user-friendly system capable of recording and transcribing live speech in real-time. The system exhibits commendable accuracy in speech recognition, making it a valuable tool for professionals and researchers in fields requiring transcription services. Furthermore, the integration of recasepunc significantly improves the readability and usability of the transcribed text. This research contributes to the automation of speech transcription, offering a practical solution to the time-consuming and error-prone process of manual transcription. The system’s versatility and ease of use make it a promising tool for enhancing productivity and accessibility in various domains. Future work may involve further optimization and the exploration of additional features to expand the system’s capabilities and applications.

articleTitle: HealthCare Chatbot Using Machine Learning and NLP
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Advances in Science and Technology (ICAST)
abstract: The healthcare sector is undergoing a paradigm shift with the integration of Artificial Intelligence (AI) chatbots into patient care. This research paper explores the transformative potential of AI chatbots in healthcare, focusing on their role in improving patient engagement and support. As healthcare systems worldwide face challenges such as rising patient volumes, limited resources, and the need for continuous care delivery, AI chatbots emerge as innovative tools to address these issues. This research paper includes study and implementation of a web-based chatbot and all the tools we have used to build our AI chatbot and a detailed study of each algorithm used for prediction along with their accuracy. Among all the algorithms K-nearest neighbour has the greatest accuracy and it is implemented in our chat application.

articleTitle: Use of Concept Mapping as a tool for Education field
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Advances in Science and Technology (ICAST)
abstract: Concept Maps serve as visual depictions of subjects, concepts, and their interconnections. They enable individuals to organize information into interconnected modules, making it easier to discern the relationships between these modules. Concept mapping offers significant potential for enhancing learning and teaching within educational settings. This potent technique can contribute to educational improvement in four distinct realms: (1) as a deliberate learning approach, (2) as an instructional method, (3) as a tool for curriculum planning, and (4) as a means of gauging students’ comprehension of scientific concepts.Concept Maps play a vital role in fostering meaningful learning among students and serve as a means of representing the collective knowledge and experiences of individuals and educational teams across various domains, including education, engineering education, science, medicine, and management courses. In the following document, we have conducted an extensive survey to consolidate numerous research endeavors related to concept maps within the aforementioned disciplines. Our aim is to simplify the research process for newcomers interested in exploring the realm of concept mapping.

articleTitle: Resume Screening Using Large Language Models
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Advances in Science and Technology (ICAST)
abstract: In today’s competitive job market, HR professionals face a significant challenge due to the overwhelming resumes received for job openings from numerous candidates. This paper attempts to provide an automated solution using one of the latest developments in ML technologies, Large Language Models (LLMs). LLMs have come into the spotlight in recent years, largely because of the introduction of Artificial Intelligence systems. The aim of this paper is to research the application of LLMs, so as to deliver a solution to the challenges faced by recruiters, thus simplifying the procedure while increasing efficiency.

articleTitle: Implementation of Number Transcription Tool
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Advances in Science and Technology (ICAST)
abstract: The creation of a precise speech-based number transcription tool that accurately transforms spoken numbers (0–9) into their corresponding digits on a screen has become extremely important in today's digital world. In order to accomplish error-free and reliable transcription of numerical data, a system using advanced speech recognition technologies was designed and implemented, as revealed by this paper. The system uses a combination of machine learning models that have been combined and trained on large datasets to provide greater transcription accuracy and adaptability to different speech patterns. This paper thoroughly explains the system's technological architecture, highlighting its features and functionalities, with particular emphasis on its capacity to convert spoken numbers into their corresponding numerical representations on a visual interface. The paper also consists of a table which provides a brief summary of the benefits and drawbacks of several models for automatic speech recognition number transcription including hybrid DNN-HMM systems, noise-robust techniques, LAS models and a comparison of our system with these existing systems. The various applications of this system include finance, telecommunications, and data entry, where precise number transcription is of utmost importance.

articleTitle: A Survey: Agricultural Supply Chain Management and Land Registration using Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Advances in Science and Technology (ICAST)
abstract: A blockchain serves as a decentralized database or ledger shared across a computer network’s nodes. It ensures data records’ integrity and security while fostering trust without reliance on a central authority. Land registry procedures in India, like in numerous regions globally, often suffer from sluggishness and inconvenience. Current land registration & verification systems include an increasing number of fraud cases and lots of paperwork and court cases due to thousands of land records to maintain. Blockchain’s implementation will eliminate intermediaries in the system and also will reduce corruption, malpractices, and mismanagement of documents. It will increase the speed of the process and make it transparent. Land Registration is a simple decentralized application. Several significant issues have been noted, such as a high volume of physical transactions and the deliberate underreporting of property sale prices to the land registry office, aiming to avoid increased value taxes. After the literature survey analysis, we came up with three common comparison factors namely; Security, Transparency and Avoidance of forgery and malpractices. These parameters have been analyzed according to a fuzzy model. All the drawbacks can be best addressed by a suitable Blockchain-based solution. This text, explains the detailed traditional land registry system and how it can be improvised with blockchain. Hence, there is a need to create a system that will allow a direct transition from the seller to the buyer so as to ease the land registry transactions modules and create a system that will be more direct, transparent and secure for all the stakeholders involved in the land registration. A detailed study has been conducted which will help the researchers to get a better perspective on the current land registry system, its drawbacks and how it can be improvised.

articleTitle: FloraMediVision: A Medicinal Plant Leaf Identification System using Computer Vision
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Advances in Science and Technology (ICAST)
abstract: The use of medicinal plants has been a fundamental aspect of traditional and alternative medicine for centuries, offering a vast reservoir of natural remedies for various health conditions. However, the accurate identification of these plants is a crucial step in ensuring their safe and effective use and it requires human expertise. In recent years, advances in computer vision and machine learning have paved the way for the development of innovative solutions to address this challenge. Using this convergence in technologies, a large number of features of leaf images have been extracted and fed to machine learning algorithms forming a cutting-edge system – the Medicinal Plant Leaf Identification System using Computer Vision - which leverages technology to revolutionize the identification of medicinal plants based on their leaves.

articleTitle: AES and its Multiple Modifications for Various Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Advances in Science and Technology (ICAST)
abstract: Network security is achieved by using cryptographic algorithms. Encryption algorithms with suitable key is used to change the original form of data into a secured format which are used in variety of applications. There are several algorithms coming under the term symmetric and asymmetric cryptography but to achieve maximum security a commonly used and proposed algorithm is Advanced Encryption Standard (AES). This review paper focuses on how modifications in AES is performed and the proposed model can be compared to improve the performance parameters for efficient utilization of algorithm by maintaining confidentiality, reducing processing time in variety of applications.

articleTitle: A Study on Cyberbullying Detection Techniques in Online Social Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Advances in Science and Technology (ICAST)
abstract: As the technological advancement, digital/social media consumption is increasing daily. Because social media sites like Twitter, Facebook, Instagram, Telegram, YouTube, and WhatsApp are so widely used, people may now engage more often, effectively, and efficiently. Cyberbullying is a sort of bullying that occurs on a digital platform with the purpose to harm and impair someone’s mental and emotional health. Cyberbullying is defined as bullying that occurs when a victim is utilizing a computer, a phone, a tablet, a social networking site, text messaging, a chat room, or other electronic device. Cyberbullying, which has become one of the most dangerous online threats for children, has caused considerable worries in the community due to the rapid growth in social media use.The proposed research work aims to design, firstly to study and analyze different issues and challenges faced by the people while using social media platforms. Secondly to develop a conventional classification framework for cyberbullying identification and prevention using machine learning. Developing a model to help in the prevention of text-based, image-based, and audio-based cyberbullying in the context of different social media platforms using a different language. The performance can be analyzed using different parameter like Accuracy, Precision, F1-score, ERR, Recall etc. Thirdly, it proposes identify and mitigate attacks based on online social media platforms. At last, to find the influence of the feature optimization or reduction on proposed classification framework.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Survey On Detection And Mitigation Of DDoS Attacks Enabled With Deep Learning Techniques In Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Advances in Science and Technology (ICAST)
abstract: To detect the DDoS (Distributed Denial of Service) attack that initiates a flooding attack over a targeted server or service meanwhile causing network traffic and disrupting legitimate users from accessing the network is significant for reducing the hosting issues and time loss. Additionally, DDoS attacks have become the foremost attack in cloud computing and cause complexity in detection and mitigation appropriately as the attacks make the server down which results in the user to loss access to the Internet and causing financial loss to the cloud computing organizations. Despite the numerous solutions that exist in the current era, the attacks continue to grow in volume as well as severity. As a consequence, multiple researchers have formulated for securing the cloud servers with the help of a software-defined network(SDN) to identify and eliminate the impacts of DDoS attacks. In this research, an in-depth analysis of the DDoS detection and mitigation frameworks for securing the servers in cloud computing is exhibited to analyze the security and authentication of attack detection systems in cloud applications. A well-defined and prominent solution can be formulated by investigators through this detailed investigation based on different datasets and techniques. The research elucidates various techniques in the detection and mitigation of DDoS attacks along with their advantages, disadvantages, and research gaps, which supports the researchers in attaining deep knowledge of the techniques prevalent in DDoS attack detection in cloud networks.

articleTitle: An Error Tracking Approach for Transmission Lines Fault Detection and Classification
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Advances in Science and Technology (ICAST)
abstract: Reliable detection of transmission line faults ensures a consistent power supply, equipment safeguards, and system efficiency. A simplified method based on tracking the mean absolute error (MAE) is presented for detecting and classifying transmission line faults. The error is calculated between ideal and faulty three-phase voltages. A distinctive advantage of the proposed method lies in its algorithmic framework and computational efficiency. The proposed technique is evaluated by simulating a 132 kV transmission line system with 11 faulty conditions. The error variation along the line is investigated to estimate the effectiveness of this approach in estimating fault locations. The proposed method exhibits superior time complexity compared to earlier reported statistical, frequency domain, and phasor-based techniques. The computation operators can be implemented in real-time for a cost-effective and scalable hardware solution.

articleTitle: Smart Lab Management using Cloud and ML
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Advances in Science and Technology (ICAST)
abstract: In the field of laboratory computer management, the transition from manual installations to an efficient and effective approach is a long-term challenge. This system represents a new system designed to revolutionize the management of laboratory computers by replacing the cumbersome manual installation process with a sophisticated automated solution. Motivated by the limitations and time-consuming nature of the legacy system, this approach uses remote server orchestration and PC configuration. This allows administrators to easily remotely manage software installations, updates and system configurations across multiple computers in the lab, ensuring consistency and reducing operational overhead.The system provides an environment to the user or any organization to efficiently manage tasks in a lab without any issues.The system not only increases efficiency, but also addresses the need for predictive maintenance and problem identification. Incorporating performance prediction mechanisms and proactive problem detection, the system offers a comprehensive solution to maintain optimal computer performance, enhancing the overall lab experience. With this system administrator gain the ability to deploy software packages and configurations across a network of lab PCs, eliminating the need for manual intervention. This system demonstrates the potential to significantly enhance the efficiency, reliability, and user experience of lab PC management, marking a significant step forward from the limitations of manual installation processes.

articleTitle: Investigation on Factors Affecting Batch Drying
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Advances in Science and Technology (ICAST)
abstract: In industries including medicines, agriculture, food, fertilizers, and chemicals, drying is among the most crucial processes. It is always desirable to dry the product in less time and area. The drying operation reduces the weight of the product and decreases the transportation cost. Time required for drying, rate of drying, humidity present in fresh air, air velocity, thickness of material are the most important factors for drying operation. In batch drying, pasty materials including wet filter cakes, lumpy solids, and pastes that may be distributed across trays are commonly dried using tray dryers. Hot air is continuously blown on the surface of the trays. Hot air absorbs moisture present in the solids and exhaust air becomes humid. Different types of batch dryer equipment’s are used in industries based up on their role, efficiency, drying rate etc. In the current studies, the impact of air velocity, cake thickness, and air temperature on dryer performance parameters is investigated. Different drying conditions are shown and explained using drying curves. The time required for drying is calculated theoretically and compared with practical time. In drying of foods & vegetables observe that the taste, texture, flavor and color changes, in some cases hardening case occur. It was noted that drying rate decreases with time but improved with air velocity and temperature.

articleTitle: Learning to Automatically Solve Algebraic Word Problems
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Advances in Science and Technology (ICAST)
abstract: We introduce an approach that automatically learns to solve algebra word problems. Our algorithm, a pioneering result for this task, reasons across sentence boundaries. It constructs and solves a system of linear equations while simultaneously recovering an alignment of the variables and numbers in these equations to the problem text. The learning algorithm incorporates varied supervision, utilizing either full equations or just the final answers.To solve these problems, our approach necessitates reasoning across sentence boundaries. It aims to identify a system of equations that concisely models the semantic relationships described in the problem text. This work represents, to the best of our knowledge, the first successful learning result for this challenging task.

articleTitle: EmpowerHer - A Guardian Wristband for Women Safety with Mobile Application
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Advances in Science and Technology (ICAST)
abstract: We live in a world where personal safety is a fundamental concern. With an ever-increasing spurge in crime against women, the existing safety measures fall short of mitigating the violence faced on a daily basis. There stands a dire need to revolutionize the current methodologies encompassing women’s safety and providing a comprehensive solution to ensure a sense of security. In response to this pressing need, EmpowerHer is an initiative to cultivate a beacon of empowerment using state-of-the-art technology like wristbands. These wristbands will seamlessly integrate with a mobile application that keeps an exhaustive track of all the data encompassing the wristband. By combining the benefits of wearable technology, intelligent software, and real-time connectivity, these wristbands incorporate location alert systems, intelligent sensor integration, seamless microphone, camera access, and other prominent security features that pave the way to ensure the safety of women with a simple wristband. These technologies incorporated in the wristband pose immediate assistance to a woman in need by notifying the concerned authorities to take necessary actions. Most importantly, it promises to bridge the gap between one’s desire to help and the lack of information about those in need, thus eliminating the uncertainty of whom to assist.

articleTitle: Cognitone: Declassifying Vocal Emotion
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Advances in Science and Technology (ICAST)
abstract: Speech emotion recognition (SER) is a crucial field that aims to accurately infer human emotions from speech signals, facilitating improved human-computer interaction. Despite the challenges associated with annotating audio data and the subjective nature of emotions, SER is essential for enhancing communication between humans and machines. In this study, we propose a novel approach based on Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) to enhance SER performance. By leveraging features like tones, pitches, and mel-frequency cepstral coefficients (MFCC), this CNN-based model achieves an impressive accuracy of 83.29%. This model surpasses existing systems by recognizing eight distinct emotions (angry, calm, disgust, fear, happy, neutral, sad, and surprised), thereby expanding the emotional spectrum captured by SER. This system is trained using a combination of the TESS and RAVDESS datasets and incorporates real-time audio recording functionality, making it a robust and versatile tool for real-world applications in speech emotion recognition.

articleTitle: A Machine Learning Model for Prediction of Parkinson’s Disease using Vocal Features
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Advances in Science and Technology (ICAST)
abstract: Parkinson’s disease is a progressive neurological disorder which affects motor skills and is characterized by symptoms such as muscle rigidity, tremors and difficulties in maintaining equilibrium and coordination. Detecting Parkinson’s disease involves analyzing the patient’s medical background and conducting multiple imaging tests like MRI, Computed Tomography, and DaTscan, along with physical and neurological assessments. All these steps are essential to validate a definitive diagnosis. Recent researches have proved that speech variations in speech can be considered as a quantifiable indicator to detect Parkinson’s disease in its early stages.This method is both non-invasive and economically efficient in contrast to alternative diagnostic procedures. To achieve a speech-based diagnosis system, we have tried a feature selection algorithm in combination with classification algorithms and a stacking classifier to combine these base models. In the process of feature selection, we have applied the mutual information gain method in combination with three classifiers: K-nearest neighbors(KNN), Support Vector Machine (SVM) and XGBoost. To evaluate various permutations, we’ve made use of the speech dataset provided UCI. To address the issue of imbalanced data, we’ve applied the Synthetic Minority Oversampling Technique (SMOTE). The stacking classifier has shown the best performance, attaining an accuracy rate of 97.05%.

articleTitle: KJSIT Learning Feedback System Development and Implementation
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Advances in Science and Technology (ICAST)
abstract: The “KJSIT Learning Feedback System” is a user-centric platform developed at the K. J. Somaiya Institute of Information Technology (KJSIT) to enhance the feedback and review system among students, faculty, and administrators. It has a user-friendly interface for registration, login, and feedback submission, and it also ensures data security and privacy. Empowering students to share insights and concerns about their education and allowing educators to make data-driven improvements, the system aligns with contemporary educational needs and trends. The methodology prioritizes user-centric environment, agile development, data-driven decision-making reports, and professional development integration. According to us, the system’s future scope includes AI and machine learning integration, and enhanced user dashboards to further enhance learning system, and data visualization methods, emphasizing continuous improvement and innovation in the quality of education within KJSIT.

articleTitle: Telehealth Innovation: The Role of Artificial Intelligence in Patient Wellness
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Advances in Science and Technology (ICAST)
abstract: Healthcare is a crucial and essential part to live a prosperous life. After the pandemic situation telehealth and telemedicine technology will play a vital role to help patients to have good health. It has become easy for doctors and healthcare providers to assess their patients through telehealth technology with time and cost efficiency. With the help of Telehealth, we can have an active and productive life. It helps to reduce stress and cure illness by providing a fitness routine that reduces and heals pain. The automation provides the system to operate according to the diagnosis of the patient. This system is not only helpful for patients but also for people who want to have a healthy life. It is time consuming and cost saving where it can provide efficient features to detect the cause and solution to prevent it. The aim of this paper is to provide healthy life by virtual assessment and recovering through the issues people are facing to remain physically and mentally fit. By self-learning by means of specialist review, simulated intelligence coordination can possibly work on understanding consideration and grow admittance to excellent clinical benefits, particularly in far off or impeded areas.

articleTitle: FortiShare: A Predictive Cloud File Sharing System for Detecting Intrusions
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Advances in Science and Technology (ICAST)
abstract: Significant advantages have resulted from improvements in data storage and collaboration through cloud-based file sharing systems. Recognizing the risk of data breaches and cyber-attacks, which calls for the installation of stronger security measures, is essential. This research focuses on a thorough examination of the current literature that highlights the demand for a secure cloud file sharing system that identifies weaknesses and anticipates future attacks before they cause any damage. The suggested system encrypts the files using the AES (Advanced Encryption Standard) algorithm before they are processed and stored. Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) are used by the system along with real-time monitoring to find weaknesses, anticipate threats, and guarantee data integrity. By keeping an eye out for abnormalities or breaches, prompt notifications are set off to bolster security protocols and further restrict malicious users. This integrated strategy contributes to strengthening cloud-based file sharing, which helps make both individuals’ and organizations’ environments safer.

articleTitle: HealthKard - A Digital Decentralized Health Identity and EHR Repository
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Advances in Science and Technology (ICAST)
abstract: Electronic health records (EHRs) have become the new standard in the healthcare industry, but they have certain disadvantages as well, such as data breaches, data silos, and ownership issues. Blockchain technology, specifically the Ethereum blockchain, offers the potential to resolve these issues by building a decentralized and secure network for the storing and exchanging of health data. This study explores the benefits and drawbacks of using an NFT-based health identification and a decentralized system for storing health records on the Ethereum blockchain. Understanding how these technologies might be applied to build a safe and open system for exchanging and storing health data, is crucial for enhancing the standard of care. In this paper, we propose an open protocol for consent to access the health records of the user using the blockchain network. This consent needs to be given by the user, and no hindrance will be faces while retrieving the medical records of the patient. The study also emphasizes the requirement for a uniform framework in India to enable digital health infrastructure in a safe, decentralized way, with benefits including user consent, portability across national boundaries and ease of access.

articleTitle: Cryptcast: E-Voting System Utilizing Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Advances in Science and Technology (ICAST)
abstract: Blockchain technology offers a promising solution to concerns about e-voting systems. Its decentralized and immutable nature ensures secure unalterable recording of votes enhancing protection against malicious attacks and boosting public trust with transparent audit trails. With smart contracts the system automates voting and tallying, reducing human intervention risks. Our blockchain-based e-voting system prioritizes voter anonymity automated user-verification blending transparency in vote counts with voter confidentiality. This approach, shown to be feasible and advantageous, could be a pivotal shift for the future of democratic elections, emphasizing integrity and transparency.

articleTitle: Waver: Hands-Free Computing - A Fusion of AI-driven Gesture based Mouse and Voice Companion
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Advances in Science and Technology (ICAST)
abstract: With the advancements in technology in recent times, it is expected to see similar improvements in Human-Computer Interactions (HCI). The rise of fields such as AI and ML have provided a platform to create solutions to make the world of technology as inclusive and accessible as possible. This research paper will explore a system that incorporates an AI-powered hand gesture interface and a voice assistant to simulate a computer mouse, and various keyboard shortcuts and perform multiple voice-operated functions. By utilizing computer vision, hand detection algorithms, natural language processing, and voice-to-text algorithms, this system enables users to interact with computers and projectors remotely through movements of their hand and various inbuilt gestures, eliminating the need for physical peripherals. The system also addresses broader challenges, including the reduction of physical contact with shared devices, and offers additional functionalities such as tab switching, music playback, brightness, and volume control. This innovative approach has the potential to redefine human-computer interaction and make it more accessible than ever before.

articleTitle: An Analysis of Techniques for Detecting Dental Care:A Brief Survey
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Advances in Science and Technology (ICAST)
abstract: Cavities, dental caries, and tooth decay are terms used to describe the deterioration of teeth caused by bacterial acid production. Pain and trouble eating are possible symptoms, and the cavities can range in color from yellow to black. Advanced diagnostic and imaging tools are utilized to identify dental caries; nevertheless, their sensitivity rates and complexity are decreased. The survey that is being given here aims to review 25 studies on the detection of oral cavities. As a result, thorough assessments of methodologies used are done and succinctly provided. This survey also shows the performances and associated maximum accomplishments of each contributor. Finally, the poll highlights a variety of research issues and flaws that may help researchers offer cutting-edge methods for detecting dental caries.

articleTitle: Air Quality Prediction Using Machine Learning: A Comparative Study
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Advances in Science and Technology (ICAST)
abstract: Clean and pure air is vital for the well-being of individuals and the environment. It is crucial in ensuring human health, environmental sustainability, and overall quality of life. Air pollution has emerged as a substantial issue in numerous urban areas, notably in developing nations like India. To ensure the preservation of ambient air quality, it is essential to engage in ongoing monitoring and forecasting of air pollution. Contrary to conventional methods, prediction of Air Quality Index (AQI) through Logistic Regression, Decision Tree Classifier and KNN shows machine learning (ML) as useful tool to understand the challenges associated with current environment. The Air Quality Index (AQI) is a vital environmental metric which quantifies the overall quality of ambient air by considering key pollutants such as RSPM (respirable suspended particulate matter), Sulphur dioxide (SO2), nitrogen dioxide (NO2), SPM (suspended particulate matter), PM2.5 and PM10 (particulate matter). It provides a comprehensive assessment of air pollution levels, aiding in public health assessments and environmental management strategies. Utilizing machine learning for the prediction of AQI enables us to discern patterns and devise effective solutions for mitigating air pollution. Objective of this research work is to train an ML model and predict patterns for the future.

articleTitle: Workout Whiz – Your Personalized AI PAL
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Advances in Science and Technology (ICAST)
abstract: Fitness training applications guide individuals in achieving their fitness goals by providing exercise routines, coaching, and form correction. This paper focuses on creation of a fitness training application named Workout Whiz which makes use of AI technologies to offer personalized coaching, immediate form correction, comprehensive progress tracking and the provision of personalized diet plans developed using python, OpenAI html, CSS and JavaScript. The application provides personalized coaching and monitoring, ensuring users perform exercises correctly and safely. It analyses users’ movements during workouts and yoga sessions, identifying any deviations from proper form and delivering instant feedback for correction. Moreover, it offers comprehensive progress tracking by recording users’ exercise history, weight lifted, and repetitions completed.

articleTitle: MindMap: A Review on Mental Health Analysis using ML
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Advances in Science and Technology (ICAST)
abstract: Mental stress on both teachers & students is a significant concern in today’s fast-paced and demanding educational environment. Both of them face academic pressure in their own set of way, students have intense competition in academics whereas teachers are often evaluated based on their student’s performance. Other examples creating mental stress are workload, social pressure, lack of support from parents in student’s case or higher authorities in teacher’s case, mental health stigma. In India people really don’t take care of their mental health or visit a psychiatrist due to the fear of people’s judgement, hence an application for analyzing mental health is great method to detect mental health issues. Accessibility: These tools are typically accessible anytime and anywhere, making mental health resources available to a wide audience. Particularly accommodating for those who may not have simply get to conventional mental wellbeing administrations. Anonymity: Some users may feel more comfortable sharing their thoughts and feelings with an app rather than a human. The anonymity of these apps can encourage individuals to open up and seek help. In this information driven world there’s a part of progression in databased instruments which can analyze the information can be utilized to think about mental wellbeing of a individual utilizing machine learning calculation. Machine learning calculations are classified into classification and clustering where a combination of both could be an important expansion to discover around the mental state of a specific individual. Algorithms like SVM, KNN, K-means Clustering, & classification algorithms.

articleTitle: Understanding and Managing Employee Attrition: Strategies for Retaining Talent
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Advances in Science and Technology (ICAST)
abstract: In this study, we address the issue of employee attrition by employing a synergistic approach that amalgamates Power BI analytics and advanced machine learning techniques. Our methodology includes a meticulous analysis of historical employee data using Power BI, uncovering subtle attrition trends, influential variables, and pertinent demographic insights. Subsequently, we engineer a predictive machine learning model that forecasts forthcoming attrition patterns and proficiently classifies employees at high risk of departure. The model’s precision is meticulously refined through rigorous feature engineering and judicious algorithm selection like Decision Trees, Gaussian NB, Random Forest, XGBoost. To actualize these insights, we develop a user-friendly Flask web application that seamlessly integrates the analytical and predictive processes. This intuitive application empowers users to input employee details and promptly receive accurate attrition predictions. Our innovative amalgamation of analytics, machine learning, and user-centric web deployment establishes a comprehensive and efficient solution. By arming organizations with actionable insights and preemptive strategies, we significantly contribute to ameliorating employee retention, fostering engagement, and augmenting overall organizational efficacy.

articleTitle: Improve Performance of DSR using Fuzzy Logic
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Advances in Science and Technology (ICAST)
abstract: The Dynamic Source Routing (DSR) protocol is a popular routing method for wireless ad hoc networks because of its ability to provide efficient and flexible routing without relying on a fixed infrastructure. However, DSR has a number of drawbacks, including significant overhead and poor performance in unpredictable and dynamic network situations. This work proposes a fuzzy logic implementation of the DSR protocol to overcome these difficulties. Fuzzy logic is a computing framework for representing and manipulating incorrect and uncertain information. By adding fuzzy logic into the DSR protocol, we want to improve its adaptability and decision-making capabilities in a variety of network situations.The fuzzy system toolkit in MATLAB is used to develop a fuzzy logic model. We evaluated the newly developed fuzzy-based routing protocol FzDSR with the AODV, DSDV, and DSR routing protocols. The implementation is assessed based on different node numbers and performance parameters. The findings show that the fuzzy logic-based DSR protocol outperforms the classic DSR approach in terms of packet delivery ratio, end-to-end delay, throughput, and routing overhead.

articleTitle: Prediction of the Value of Pre-owned Cars using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Advances in Science and Technology (ICAST)
abstract: The pre-owned car market has experienced a significant growth within the automotive industry, fueled by factors such as affordability, improved vehicle reliability, accurate valuation of pre-owned cars holds pivotal importance for both buyers and sellers, directly influencing pricing decisions. This research paper seeks to develop a model to predict the correct value of pre-owned cars by employing the potent Random Forest algorithm, renowned for its efficiency in handling intricate regression problems. The study leverages a comprehensive dataset encompassing diverse vehicle attributes to train and assess the performance of the model. The output derived from this study will empower stakeholders in the automotive industry to make proper decisions when buying or selling pre-owned vehicles.

articleTitle: 5.8GHz ISM Band Low Cost Button Antenna for Smart Wearable Application
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Advances in Science and Technology (ICAST)
abstract: A low-cost button antenna for smart wearable applications using a probe feed technique operating at 5.8 GHz is proposed in this paper. Antennas used for wearable wireless communication and biomedical RF systems must be feather-light. The antenna is designed to be compact and efficient, with a radiation pattern that minimizes the effects on the user’s body. The design is optimized with ANSYS HFSS software to achieve the needed performance parameters. The designed antenna with patch radius 8.5mm operates at frequency 5.83 GHz with S11=-20.59dB. The gain directivity obtained is 4.0dB, gain obtained is 1.7dB, Bandwidth 315MHz which is quite good for wearable applications, with SAR 1.21W/Kg which is within FCC limit. The base material used is low cost FR4 epoxy having 4.4 relative permittivity and 0.16cm height. Copper is utilized as conductive stuff. The final antenna design is fabricated and tested to corroborate its performance and the results prove that the fabricated antenna meets the needed specifications. The compact size and efficient performance make the antenna suitable for use in a wide range of smart wearables, including smartwatches, fitness trackers and health monitoring bias, operating in the 5.8 GHz ISM band designed using FR4 material.

articleTitle: Crowdfunding Campaigns Web Application using Metamask
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Advances in Science and Technology (ICAST)
abstract: The work presented in this paper discusses crowdfunding. It is platform where innumerable people, group of people, organization or companies are able to contribute. Investors are able to contribute to project they are passionate about and earn profit also, typically when someone needs to raise money to launch a business. Conventionally, most organization use hard cash for the transaction purpose, where very less amount of investors is able to contribute as the process is traditional. After the COVID-19 most of the work is in hybrid mode. In case of online transaction various security issues like money frauds etc comes; because of that investor’s participation is less. To implement proposed system in transparent and secure way the blockchain is used, where investors invest money in terms of cryptocurrency. As there is use of blockchain, investor can participate from anywhere. Crowdfunding powered by blockchain modifies the traditional method of financing. Web application is designed where all the investors participate and Metamask wallet is used by investors. Blockchain is immutable, transparent, decentralized and distributed so the security accomplishment is very virtuous.

articleTitle: Modern Dating Applications and their contribution to increase of SAD in Young Adults
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Advances in Science and Technology (ICAST)
abstract: This study aims to examine the relation between Social Anxiety Disorder (SAD) and Modern Dating Applications. With an increasing number of young adults taking refuge in using such Dating Applications due to social anxiety they might be nudged into depression and a feeling of loneliness due to the design of these applications. This in turn is the reason to give rise to an increase in social anxiety among these individuals, creating a vicious cycle. The study is based on surveys consisting of several young adults.

articleTitle: Predicting the Spread of Covid Disease Based on Chest X-Ray Images Using Convolutional Neural Network with Improved Accuracy
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Advances in Science and Technology (ICAST)
abstract: The major intent of this article is to forecast the spread of corona disease based on x-ray images with an improved accuracy rate by using a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) in comparison with the Naive Bayes (NB) Classifier. Materials & Methods: The data set in this paper utilizes the publicly available Kaggle corona data set. The sample size for identifying the corona based on thorax x-ray images with the improved precision rate was sample 1000 (Group 1=500 and Group 2=500) and the alpha and beta values of 0.06,0.3 are used for calculating G-power 0.7 with a confidence interval at 95%. Predicting the spread of corona disease based on thorax x-ray images with improved accuracy rate is performed by Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) whereas the number of samples in Naive Bayes (N=10). Results: The CNN classifier has a 95.686640 high accuracy rate while compared to the accuracy rate of Naive Bayes (NB) is 91.251527. The study has a significance value of p<0.05 i.e. p=0.0271. Conclusion: Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) provides better outcomes in accuracy rate when compared to Naive Bayes (NB) for forecasting the spread of corona disease based-on thorax X-ray images.

articleTitle: FEED - Food Enduetion and Donation
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Advances in Science and Technology (ICAST)
abstract: Considering the growing global concern about food waste and its environmental and social impacts, this study introduces the Food Endue and Donation (FEED) mobile application. The core objective of FEED is to act as a crucial intermediary, connecting food donors with surplus food to individuals and organizations serving those in need. The application was subjected to practical trials within student hostels, which provided valuable insights into its functionality and usability. FEED demonstrated a user-friendly interface and showed promising potential for future integration with artificial intelligence, elevating its efficiency and impact. Aligned with the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals, particularly those focused on reducing poverty and improving public health, FEED is an important step towards promoting smart urban living. By optimizing the process of redistributing surplus food, this application aims to significantly reduce food waste while addressing the critical issue of global hunger. This paper highlights the importance of using modern technology to create a sustainable and equitable future.

articleTitle: Chaining Success: How Blockchain Reshapes the Landscape of Supply Chain
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Advances in Science and Technology (ICAST)
abstract: This study thoroughly explores the integration of blockchain technology into supply chain management, capitalizing on its core attributes of decentralization, immutability, and transparency. It delves into diverse applications and tangible benefits that blockchain introduces, including heightened transparency, traceability, security, and operational efficiency in supply chain processes. Real-world examples showcased in the study illustrate how blockchain establishes an unalterable ledger, ensuring authenticity and provenance. Moreover, the study introduces a meticulous methodology for adopting blockchain in supply chains. This method covers identifying pain points, assessing compatibility, formulating integration protocols, and devising strategies for user adoption. Practical case studies offer tangible insights, providing organizations with a practical roadmap for integrating blockchain into their supply chain operations. However, the paper candidly addresses challenges inherent in this transformative integration, such as scalability, interoperability, regulatory compliance, and user adoption. The paper envisions a future where blockchain converges with emerging technologies like AI and IoT, fostering an interconnected, data-driven supply chain network poised for innovation and resilience. In essence, it provides a comprehensive understanding of the pivotal role played by blockchain in modern supply chain management. By leveraging decentralization, immutability, smart contracts, transparency, and interoperability, it establishes a robust foundation. The paper also highlights the importance of addressing challenges through collaboration and innovation, pointing towards a future where blockchain, AI, and IoT converge to create an interconnected and innovative supply chain landscape.

articleTitle: Voice Based Authentication – An Alternative to OTPs
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Advances in Science and Technology (ICAST)
abstract: The traditional method of authentication using a one-time password does not provide enough security for web pages or applications that are a gateway to sensitive information/data. Sensitive data breaches have become a common thing in today’s world and have caused great losses to individuals, organizations and nations as well. With advancement in technology, access to OTP has become a piece of cake and sensitive data has become vulnerable. Given the gravity of the situation, a more secure way of authentication has become the need of the hour, therefore voice-based authentication is a better successor to the traditional method and is more secure. In this paper we have collected the voice sample and processed it using the MFCC method to extract the voice print and then used Gaussian Mixture Model to find similarity between the stored voice and the live voice.

articleTitle: Review of Role of AI in Data Warehousing and Mining
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Advances in Science and Technology (ICAST)
abstract: The contemporary era, characterized by an unprecedented surge in data, has magnified the importance of integrating Artificial Intelligence (AI) with data warehousing and mining. This amalgamation not only facilitates efficient data storage and quicker retrieval but also offers sophisticated tools for recognizing intricate patterns within datasets. AI’s capability to harness deep learning and other advanced algorithms in data mining significantly improves predictive accuracy and enables more intelligent data warehousing solutions. However, as promising as this integration seems, it also presents challenges, notably in algorithm interpretability and ensuring robust data security. This review provides a comprehensive exploration of the recent advancements, inherent benefits, and prevailing concerns surrounding AI’s role in data warehousing and mining. Through this examination, the transformative potential of AI in this domain is highlighted, while also emphasizing areas that warrant further research and development.

articleTitle: Review: DeepFake Detection Techniques using Deep Neural Networks (DNN)
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Advances in Science and Technology (ICAST)
abstract: In the age of advanced digital manipulation, deepfake videos pose a significant threat to society by allowing the creation of highly convincing counterfeit footage. The application of deep learning has proven instrumental in tackling an extensive array of practical issues and real-world applications. However, alongside its substantial benefits, there exist certain disadvantages. Deepfake videos involve the substitution of one person's characteristics with those of another, achieved through the application of advanced Deep Learning techniques. This technology can be exploited with harmful intentions, leading to the dissemination of misinformation, manipulation, and persuasive content. This paper explores multiple deep learning techniques designed for detecting deep fake images and videos. It conducts a comparative analysis of these techniques, including CNN models like ResNet, VGG16, and Efficient Net, along with RNN models like LSTM, to assess their effectiveness in deepfake video detection.

articleTitle: The Fusion of AI and Music Generation: A Comprehensive Review
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Advances in Science and Technology (ICAST)
abstract: The integration of artificial intelligence (AI) and music generation has revolutionized the field of musical composition, ushering in a new era of creative possibilities. This comprehensive review explores two groundbreaking studies that illustrate the profound impact of AI in music: AI-driven music remixing and AI-generated music composition. The first approach employs state-of-the-art deep learning and neural network architectures to enhance music remixing by recognizing intricate audio patterns, resulting in remarkably inventive remixes. The second method harnesses generative adversarial networks (GANs) and reinforcement learning to compose original music pieces that rival human-created compositions. Both studies exemplify AI’s capacity to reshape the landscape of musical creativity, offering novel avenues for artistic expression. This paper not only examines these pioneering studies but also delves into the broader implications of AI in music, highlighting its potential to revolutionize music production and inspire a new generation of musicians.

articleTitle: PARICHAI - Personal Aadhar Referenced Identification of Missing Children and Alzheimer patients of India
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Advances in Science and Technology (ICAST)
abstract: The objective of this project is to combat human trafficking, especially child trafficking. Human trafficking is a huge industry recognized as the fastest growing criminal industry in the world. Human trafficking has many components, including sex trafficking, human trafficking and organ trafficking. Alzheimer’s disease is a brain disease that gradually deteriorates thinking and memory capacities, as well as the ability to do even the most fundamental tasks. Alzheimer’s patients may forget their own home and become disoriented when returning home. Biometrics are to be used to identify a missing person. For this, the system is to be linked with the Aadhar biometrics information system. Fingerprints are like unique keys you carry everywhere. Nine biometric technologies exist, including face, fingerprint, hand shape biometrics, hand vein, retinal scan, iris, signature, voice of a person, and isometric expressions. Considering all those biometrics, Fingerprint has more wholeness and uniqueness. As we know, UIDAI does not permit using anyone’s fingerprint without their consent. However, according to reports, it does allow it in some serious situations. The app will be developed for the government which means only the authorized senior officials of government can make use of PARICHAI. The government can deploy this app in their suitable and secure domain to prevent cyber threats. The address of the victim will be mapped to the Aadhar database as the address of the victim and the family members will be the same. The Aadhar database resides with the government itself. The list of people whose address maps with the victim will be listed. The UID, contact details and address is only listed. The biometric information is not disclosed to the official to respect their privacy. It is a contemporary identification system that will serve as the provisional culmination. It works on ongoing development of identifying systems. Each of which offers a fresh, improved approach to the enduring issue of permanently resolving identities. The only disadvantage of the system here is non-updated Aadhar card.

Author Keywords: Fingerprint sensor and matching system model

articleTitle: AI Revolution in Agriculture of India
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Advances in Science and Technology (ICAST)
abstract: The rapid advancement of artificial intelligence (AI) technology has ushered in a new era of transformation in various sectors, and India’s agriculture sector is no exception. This paper analyzes the profound impact of the AI revolution on Indian agriculture, its multifaceted contributions and potential implications. Through an extensive review of literature, case studies and empirical data, this study explores innovative applications of AI in crop management, yield forecasting, pest control, soil health assessment and supply chain optimization. This paper provides a comprehensive overview of the AI revolution in the Indian agriculture sector and highlights its transformative potential and highlights the importance of a comprehensive and inclusive approach

articleTitle: Printed Gujarati Text Detection and Recognition (PGTDR)
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Advances in Science and Technology (ICAST)
abstract: India is the land of many historic manuscripts and parchments. More than one-third Indian manuscripts are written in Gujarati, according to statistics from the National Mission for Manuscripts. Since handwritten data on paper is difficult to maintain, digitizing these manuscripts and storing them in a database proves helpful in their preservation. The research will use machine learning models trained on a custom dataset to recognize Gujarati text and convert it into a machine-readable format. The research presents an effective, robust and high-precision system to conveniently digitize these manuscripts, using YOLOv8 for character detection with 98% precision and DenseNet model for text recognition with 99.2% accuracy. The system is also capable of detecting text blocks in newspaper articles and this proof of concept will be extremely efficient for detection of texts in Gujarati manuscripts.

articleTitle: Stylized Devanagari Script License Plate Conversion to Standard Script using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Advances in Science and Technology (ICAST)
abstract: It is an interesting observation in many states in India, that, for reasons best known to the vehicle owners, they install a “stylized” number plate on their vehicles. A number plate apart from the allowed format is against the vehicle registration act. For the existing camera installations and automated fine generation systems in Digital India, it becomes difficult for the law enforcing authorities to capture the actual number and impose fine without human intervention. This paper attempts to tackle this problem, restricted to the state of Maharashtra in India. It proposes a system that recognizes local Devanagari script and stylized script on License plates and converts it to standard script. Machine learning and deep learning methods are used to solve these cases. Further, a web-based app is developed which becomes handy for the law enforcement authorities for use of this technology. The system reports an accuracy of 97% on complete Devanagari scripts and 85% accuracy on the stylized Devanagari script. The work may further be used for other applications like archiving heritage literature handwritten in Devanagari by converting it to roman script. The work also defines further scope of using similar techniques in converting historical documents in long forgotten scripts like the "modi" script to the benefit of interested learners.

articleTitle: Crops Recommendation: An Extensive Review and Comparative Study of Machine Learning Methods
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Advances in Science and Technology (ICAST)
abstract: The project seeks to transform the agricultural supply chain through the development of a web application that empowers farmers to sell their produce directly to warehouse owners and retailers, bypassing the constraints imposed by intermediaries. This initiative aims to bridge the gap between farmers and buyers, promoting fairness, efficiency, and transparency within the trading ecosystem. In traditional agricultural trading systems, intermediaries often diminish farmers’ profits and obscure pricing transparency. The platform addresses these challenges by enabling farmers to create profiles, list their agricultural products for sale, and engage directly with warehouse owners and retailers. Additionally, the data analytics tools offer valuable market insights. This methodology outlines the key steps involved in the development of the platform, encompassing front-end and back-end development, data analytics, and the expected outcomes of empowering farmers, enhancing transparency, improving efficiency, and promoting user engagement.

articleTitle: Smart Posture Analyzer For Exercise
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Advances in Science and Technology (ICAST)
abstract: Going to the gym on your own is, of course, possible, but a personal trainer can really help you increase your endurance. In this day and age, many people rely on YouTube tutorial videos to figure out what works best for them. However, if done unsupervised or incorrectly, it can be ineffective and potentially dangerous. During exercise, sudden movements and poor posture can result in temporary or permanent disability. So, we devised this smart exercise posture analyzer concept. By alerting the user and providing alternative actions, the system warns the user about poor posture. This would allow the user to focus on the exercise rather than the mobile screen. The idea is to track the body posture of the user while they are doing exercise and recommend changes simultaneously. The system will also keep track of reps the user is doing. The proposed system does not consider more than 3 exercises. Algorithms based on machine learning are used to predict and guide users when performing specific workouts.

articleTitle: Crime investigation using Big Data on CDR
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Advances in Science and Technology (ICAST)
abstract: In this digital era, every digital movement or change can be captured. One of the forms can be the telecommunication data and call detail records (CDR) when a person makes a call to each other. This data, after stream processing, can be analyzed on a real time basis using Spark and other technologies. This analysis can help to target the culprits behind various crimes by identifying the patterns involved in central crime figures. Great potential is associated with analyzing this data by uncovering patterns and relationships to identify suspicious callers and associated crime patterns. In this paper, we will discuss the significance of integrating cloud computing and Big data technologies in identifying criminal networks by using sophisticated algorithms. This research aims to identify the culprits behind any criminal act by analyzing the digital logs produced by any person in CDR. Identifying patterns to detect criminals by using call records holds significant potential for aiding crime investigations. This research considers 5 major telecom companies in India and with use of stream processing algorithms we can identify criminal patterns in the telecommunication records.

articleTitle: Implementation of Digital Carbon Footprint Emission Estimator and Predictor for Mobile Devices
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Advances in Science and Technology (ICAST)
abstract: With the surge in digitalization and the increasing usage of technology, there has been a significant increase in the digital carbon footprint. General people at least have some kind of awareness about the carbon footprint generated by industries, fuel consumption etc. But many people even do not think about how their mobile phones are contributing to generating a special kind of carbon footprint called digital carbon footprint. This paper proposes an application that aims to detect the screen time of different apps of an individual user, thereby calculating and accounting for the overall carbon footprint of the user. To predict the future carbon footprint a user can generate, a machine learning model was designed. The major objective of this study is to explore the various sources and gather information about the digital carbon footprint generated by different mobile applications, measuring the screen time of individual applications and thus calculating the digital carbon footprint. The application generates the digital carbon footprint of individual application as well as show the cumulative value of the digital carbon footprint by considering the contribution of all application and predicting their future value of it.

Index Terms: Least Absolute Shrinkage And Selection Operator

articleTitle: Customer Segmentation Analysis using K-means Algorithm with Elbow method and Dendrogram
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Advances in Science and Technology (ICAST)
abstract: In today’s competitive business environment, it is crucial to do marketing effectively based on the customer buying habits and requirements. By analyzing the buying habits of customers, companies can enhance customer’s shopping experiences. The analysis can be done with the help of a method called customer segmentation. It is the process of grouping customers into different clusters based on similar characteristics. In this paper, we have done customer segmentation using the k-means algorithm which is an unsupervised learning method and it focuses on grouping the data points into clusters where each point resides in a cluster with the nearest centroid. The accuracy for the optimal number of clusters is verified using a dendrogram where the number of clusters is equal to the number of points obtained by drawing a imaginary horizontal line bisecting through the most extended vertical line of the graph. This analysis gives insights based on customer buying habits which helps companies build marketing strategies for the targeted audience that will improve client retention and overall revenue of business.

articleTitle: Synergy of Artificial Intelligence and Music
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Advances in Science and Technology (ICAST)
abstract: This comprehensive paper delves into the intricate relationship between Music and Artificial Intelligence (AI). It presents an extensive overview of the current developments in this emerging field and explores the potential future applications. The paper goes beyond the surface, emphasizing that music is not just a melodious tune but a complex data set that AI can efficiently manipulate. It investigates how AI can affect human brain functionality through music, discusses AI’s role in automated music composition, and highlights its significance in assisting impaired individuals in playing music. Furthermore, the paper predicts the future of AI in the music industry, considering its possibility for transformation.

articleTitle: Modeling Marine Ecosystem Dynamics using Markov Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Advances in Science and Technology (ICAST)
abstract: Comprehensive modeling faces major obstacles when dealing with marine ecosystems due to their intricate and interdependent ecological components. With a focus on species interactions, nutrient cycling, and responses to external stimuli, this study uses Markov networks to disentangle the complex dynamics of marine ecosystems. By utilizing a probabilistic approach, we examine the ecosystem’s stability and resilience, exposing significant species interactions and uncovering trends in the dynamics of nutrient cycling. Our model offers important insights into vulnerabilities related to climate change by simulating responses to external influences. Sensitivity analysis pinpoint crucial variables for ecosystem management, and validation of the model against actual data shows its accuracy. Future conditions of the marine ecosystem can be inferred from long-term forecasts that are based on dynamic probabilities. Through the contribution of this research, a more detailed understanding of the dynamics of marine ecosystems is gained, enabling informed decision-making for conservation and sustainable resource management.

articleTitle: An Ensemble model to analyze the sentiments of Textual Data for Monitoring and Comprehending Racist Views
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Advances in Science and Technology (ICAST)
abstract: Sentiment analysis, which seeks to examine and comprehend the underlying sentiment or emotion portrayed in textual data, has grown to be a significant topic of research in natural language processing. The proliferation of user-generated information on social media sites like Twitter/X makes them an ideal source for sentiment analysis investigations. This abstract provides a thorough analysis of sentiment analysis using a Twitter/X dataset with a comparison of the effectiveness of conventional machine learning models as the main topic. This study's main goal is to categorize posts as racist or sexist or non-racist or non-sexist. The Twitter/X dataset is preprocessed to eliminate noise such as stop words, URLs, mentions, and hashtags before being tokenized to extract useful features. Evaluation criteria like accuracy, F-score are used to evaluate each model's performance. The experimental findings and comparison analyses offer insightful information for real-world uses like social media sentiment analysis.

articleTitle: Verifier: Marksheet Verification using Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Advances in Science and Technology (ICAST)
abstract: The verification of academic Marksheets is a challenging task for industries as it requires communication with educational institutions to ensure accuracy. The counterfeit marksheets further complicate this process, demanding verification of marksheet which require valuable time. To overcome this we propose a blockchain-based solution that uses a decentralized ledger and, hence has no central authority which provides a solution to verify marksheet easily and efficiently. The digital marksheets are authenticated by administrators, and then the hash of marksheet is securely stored on the blockchain with the seat number. This hash serves as a unique identifier. Our web application facilitates easy verification of a student’s marksheet authenticity. By converting the digital marksheet into a cryptographic hash and cross-referencing it with the blockchain’s hash, the system offers a streamlined and dependable means of authentication, addressing the industry’s verification challenges efficiently.

articleTitle: Somaiya’s Tutorial: An Online Education Portal
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Advances in Science and Technology (ICAST)
abstract: The landscape of the education system has transformed significantly since the arrival of digital technology,and various online education portals have played a fundamental role in this transforming journey. Somaiya’s Tutorial, an enhanced online education platform, has gathered eyes for its innovative digital and virtual learning approach. This research paper conveys a comprehensive analysis of the Somaiya Tutorial, ranging from its foundation to its inherent impact on the prevailing education system. Through an in-depth analysis, it seeks to shed light on the portal’s effectiveness, its key features, how it facilitates the outcome, adaption to modern surroundings, and the quality of user experience. In the introductory section, the paper discusses the need for online education and how can it be delivered to the students and masses in an effective manner. The second section indulges in varied key features and functionality to which the portal adheres. Along with that, it focuses attention on interactive learning elements such as discussion portals, and live sessions that help students in collaborating and fostering among themselves. The paper further runs through various instances and parameters for checking the effectiveness of the platform. Moving ahead it highlights the accessibility of the portal through both web-based as well as mobile applications. This helps in reducing education gaps in remote areas. Mainly the paper explores the potential impact of Somaiya Tutorial on the current education system. It endorses the role of democratizing education by providing high-quality resources to a wide range of audiences, regardless of their socioeconomic and geographical background. Additionally, the paper points out the scalability and adaptability of the platform, making it suitable for future developments in Online education systems involving various subject coverage and AI-driven enhancements.

articleTitle: Enhanced Cognitive Learning with Augmented Reality: An Application for Interactive Learning (ARLearn)
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Advances in Science and Technology (ICAST)
abstract: Experiential learning has gained importance lately in academics. Educators are facilitating Learning by Doing in classrooms. But this may not be possible in many circumstances, especially for schools in remote areas with limited resources. This proposed work is about a technology to bridge this gap and help educators. There is a need for making the learning process interactive for kids of primary and preprimary section in order to build fundamental abilities of reading and understanding their surroundings. ARLearn bridges a paperback book with AR Technology. The AR Technology is designed to make the book content become alive in 3D over any simple smartphone with an interactive storyline. This helps kids to enjoy the learning process. ARLearn (Augmented Reality Learning Book) illustrates the evolution of a new notion of virtual interpretation of classic textbooks and audio-visual information in learners native language. The goal of this application is to help in developing reading habits in kids at an early age by facilitating them to understand the content of books in their own language as well as in English. It is suggested that kids at an early age have a very powerful imagination. Books, where they get accompanying technology to help in understanding, could be the solution that helps the kids to flourish their thinking skills. Using augmented reality technology, which incorporates new technological approaches, allows the user to experience the book content while enjoying and interacting with the information, enhancing the cognitive learning experience.

articleTitle: STM32 Based Quadcopter For Obstacle Avoidance Using Ultrasonic Sensor
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Advances in Science and Technology (ICAST)
abstract: This research paper presents the development of a drone system that is based on a quadcopter and utilizes an ultrasonic sensor for evaluating obstacles and measuring altitude. The project employs an STM32 microcontroller and Arduino programming to establish a quadcopter platform that is both affordable and educational. The system encompasses various functionalities such as auto-leveling and altitude maintenance. The hardware components and calibration procedures are extensively elucidated to ensure a flight that is safe and dependable. The paper highlights the importance of calibrating the sensor, balancing the motors and propellers, and effectively implementing obstacle avoidance and altitude measurement capabilities. In conclusion, this project offers a comprehensive resolution for self-sufficient drone navigation and control.
