articleTitle: A Case Study of MyntraTM Enhancing E-Commerce Retailing with Multiple AI Solutions
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Advances in Science and Technology (ICAST)
abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) is been proved as most effective in terms of enhancing the end-customer experience in e-commerce, same way it is also beneficial for optimizing brand reputation, and boosting company’s growth in the quickly changing online retail industry. In this case study of Myntra, one of the most popular online shopping website for modern fashion trends in India, which gained advantages from the power of numerous AI strategies to maintain its position as a leading e-commerce brand. Myntra is up to mark in terms of providing customized shopping experiences to its end users with the help of machine learning to observe user’s activity and interest. Through integration of chatbots and product recommendations, voice assistance, visual match etc. help them to have better customer engagement and retention. Myntra is quite good with insights by using data analytics to enhance logistics and reduce order fulfillment times. AI is considered as core strategy of Myntra to optimize the multiple operations, having a better knowledge of market demand and reacting on latest fashion trends, reducing existing costs and cutting out the of most possible discount offerings. Myntra is also working with computer vision in order to identify shapes, patterns, and colors such that they can generate fashion that satisfied consumer needs at a rate that would be impossible for traditional and existing apparel manufacturers to match. Myntra’s journey showcase the power of AI in changing the face of online retail.

articleTitle: Ensemble Learning based Efficient Spam Detection of YouTube Comments
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Advances in Science and Technology (ICAST)
abstract: The relentless proliferation of spam comments on popular video-sharing platforms, most notably YouTube, has made it increasingly challenging for users to sift through and locate valuable contributions amidst the noise. This work focuses on the development and deployment of a machine learning-based spam detection system tailored specifically for YouTube comments and empower channel owners, content creators with a user-friendly GUI application that streamlines comment moderation, allowing them to maintain a positive comments section and prevent potential viewership loss due to low-quality comments. We applied a wide range of machine learning algorithms, including the Support Vector Classifier with Radial Basis Function Kernel (SVM RBFK), Decision Tree, Random Forest, Multi-Layer Perceptron Classifier (MLP Classifier), Multinomial Naive Bayes, KNN Classifier, and Logistic Regression, along with a single ensemble model known as the Ensemble Stacking Model. The K nearest neighbor showed the worst performance for our model so we had to drop it from the list. To assess the model's performance, we employed three essential evaluation metrics: Accuracy, Matthew's Correlation Coefficient (MCC), and F1 score. Our analysis of the evaluation results demonstrates the model's exceptional accuracy in distinguishing spam comments within the YouTube comment landscape.

articleTitle: MOODIFY: Tailored, Personal and Multifaceted AI Assistant for Young Adult Mental Health Issues
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Advances in Science and Technology (ICAST)
abstract: Mental health issues are prevalent among young adults aged 20-35, who face stresses related to studies, work, finances, and personal relationships. We present Moodify, an Android application to identify, analyze, and alleviate mental health problems at an early stage. The app has three key features: 1) An emotion detection module that divides the face into lines to extract and predict emotions, then recommends uplifting songs and podcasts based on the user’s current state. 2) An autonomous chatbot for users to privately discuss their feelings and receive suggested coping strategies without revealing their identity. 3) Anonymous group chat rooms where users can socialize and discuss common problems anonymously. Moodify aims to improve mental wellbeing by allowing users to monitor their emotional state through facial analysis, vent feelings safely to an AI, and connect with peers undergoing similar issues while maintaining privacy. Evaluations demonstrate the emotion detection module can identify facial expressions indicative of mood with 82% accuracy. The chatbot is effectively being designed for reducing negative sentiment through supportive conversations. Moodify represents a novel mobile approach to enhancing mental health through emotionally intelligent systems and secure social features tailored to young adults’ needs. The app empowers users to privately manage mental health issues by increasing self-awareness, providing personalized support, and facilitating anonymous peer discussions.

articleTitle: Roadmap of Renewable Energy Generation
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Advances in Science and Technology (ICAST)
abstract: Renewable energy is created from non-depleting, naturally replenishing sources like the sun and wind. In this research we have done the materialistic and mathematical study of solar panel, sun position, sun radiation, panel module temperature, cell temperature, wind speed, with respect to region such as latitude and longitude which leads us to propose new architecture and its simulated implementation based on the fundamental concept provided by NREL and its datasets for new energy generation.New proposed architecture will work on principles of Lotus flower, Sunflower, and bifacial panels. The new architecture is self-operable based on sunlight, as light falls on panel petals, it will open its petals. To receive the most sunlight, it rotates the solar panel petals in accordance with the position of the sun. Bifacial solar panels generate power using both sides of panel petals. It absorbs sun radiation from the front side as well as back sides. With this architecture we can generate 5-20 % of efficient energy. Photovoltaic (PV) performance index is used to validate the simulation findings in the end.

articleTitle: Campus Placement using Machine Learning: An Extensive Review and Comparative Study of Machine Learning Methods
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Advances in Science and Technology (ICAST)
abstract: Unemployment has been one of the most socio-economic issues. Many countries are facing challenges related to both open unemployment where individuals are actively seeking jobs and are unable to find them. In the present era of education and workforce dynamics is characterized by diversity, demanding many innovative ideas, tools and strategies for talent matching and resource allocation methods. The traditional methods of placement process are often reliant on manual evaluations and are quite inadequate in meeting the needs for individuals and organizations. This study highlights the reasons behind the growing need for Machine Learning based placement assessment. It ensures efficient talent matching, reducing costs, and saving time. The paper highlights the advantages of remote and flexible assessments, displaying how technology can replace the old methods of hiring.

articleTitle: Facial Expression based Assistant for Interviewee using Video Processing
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Advances in Science and Technology (ICAST)
abstract: An Interview is a conversation between a job applicant(interviewee) and a representative of an organization, which is conducted to assess whether the applicant is capable enough to be hired by the organization. It usually consists of a formal questionnaire which determines the applicant’s suitability for a job. But on an important day like a job interview, many lose confidence. The proposed model is designed to analyze various factors based on the emotion analysis of an interviewee using OpenCV. The model will fetch information from the video generated from the camera placed in front of the interviewee. The video goes as an input to the model and the model extracts information from the video. The model will fetch the information like the facial features of the candidate. Based on the information generated from the frames, the model creates a dataset and analyzes the interviewee to determine his confidence, concentration and nervousness while appearing for the interview.

articleTitle: Review: Converging Encryption, Hashing and Steganography for Data Fortification
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Advances in Science and Technology (ICAST)
abstract: In today’s digital world, storing and transmitting sensitive data electronically is common but risky due to the potential for unauthorized access, disclosure, modification, or destruction. To tackle this challenge, our proposed system offers a comprehensive solution focusing on secure data transmission. AES-GCM or Advanced Encryption Standard in Galois/Counter Mode, is a type of encryption. with flip and rotational LSB (Least Significant Bit) steganography techniques to ensure secure data transmission and covert concealment within digital images This integrated approach offers a single, robust platform that not only guarantees the confidentiality of data but also verifies its integrity and enables covert communication within image files. The goal of our proposed system is to increase data confidentiality by allowing secret data transfers inside seemingly benign pictures.

articleTitle: Signature Authentication Verification using Siamese Network
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Advances in Science and Technology (ICAST)
abstract: Signature verification plays a pivotal role in ensuring security across various domains, including financial transactions, legal documents, and access control systems. Traditionally, authentication systems have relied on specific pointers or reference points within a signature to confirm its legitimacy. However, this approach has inherent limitations as it assumes the consistent presence of these reference points across different instances of the signature. In this paper, we introduce an approach to signature verification that eliminates the dependence on pointers or reference points. Instead, we propose a machine learning-based technique that leverages the unique characteristics of signature strokes and patterns to establish authenticity. By analyzing features such as stroke pressure, speed and curvature, our system can accurately verify their validity without the need for predefined pointers or reference templates. Our signature verification system employs a sophisticated neural network architecture trained on an extensive dataset comprising genuine and forged signatures. Through rigorous experimentation and validation processes, we demonstrate the system’s robustness and remarkable accuracy in distinguishing authentic signatures from forgeries, even in cases where traditional pointer-based methods may falter. This innovative approach offers unparalleled flexibility and adaptability in accommodating evolving signature styles and variations. By enhancing security and providing a more versatile solution, our approach represents a significant step forward in the field of signature verification, with far-reaching implications for a wide range of industries and applications.

articleTitle: Enhanced Hate Speech Detection Using Various Machine Learning Models and Performance Comparison
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Advances in Science and Technology (ICAST)
abstract: In this hate speech detection system, the team embarked on a mission to combat the rising tide of online hate speech, a prevalent issue in the digital landscape. Leveraging a diverse array of machine learning models, including Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN), Naive Bayes, Linear SVM, Logistic Regression, and Random Forest, the team meticulously evaluated their performance on a dataset sourced from Kaggle. The journey involved extensive data preprocessing, tokenization, and feature engineering, refining the dataset for rigorous analysis. Through a comprehensive assessment of accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score metrics, the team unveiled the strengths and capabilities of each model. The findings from this provide valuable insights into the effectiveness of these models in identifying instances of hate speech, contributing to the ongoing efforts to foster inclusive and respectful online communication.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Framework for Early Detection of Diseases in Coconut Tree from Leaf Images
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Advances in Science and Technology (ICAST)
abstract: Coconut tree is one of the most beneficial and popular crops in the world due to its numerous uses. In countries like India, Indonesia, Philippines, Sri Lanka, etc., people primarily depend on coconut farming for their livelihood. Pest infestation or disease can largely affect the production of crops and lead to losses. Finding the disease at its earliest stage of development is necessary for disease control in plants. Image processing technologies, computer vision and deep learning models are now-a-days used to detect disease in crops. Many researchers have developed effective methods using deep learning models for disease detection, Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) and various architectures of CNNs are used for Disease Detection in plants. This study aims to review various research methodologies and apply them to a new dataset that includes images of leaves classified primarily into 5 diseases: yellowing, drying, flaccidity, caterpillars, and leaflets. CNN, DenseNet121, InceptionResNetV2, and ANN were major algorithms used in study.InceptionResNetV2 CNN, and DenseNet121 all performed remarkably well and provided the desired accuracy of around 99% and higher.

articleTitle: Estimation of Crypto Net Worth using Zero Knowledge Proof
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Advances in Science and Technology (ICAST)
abstract: The bane of cryptocurrency wallets is that there are too many of them. Many wallets support only a few individual currencies or a set of currencies. They are preferred over generic wallets, which cover all currencies, as each is quite functional and practical for their given currencies over their generic counterparts. We need a system that provides us with all our currencies and their values in one spot so we can have an overview or look at all our investments at a glance. The solution is a Dapp which enables us to link all our wallets in one place and provide a dashboard with the complete crypto net worth across various chains and wallets. An understated privacy issue is seen in many places; like when applying for visas to other countries, we often have to show our bank statements to prove our net worth. This example also holds for cryptocurrencies. If a user wants to reveal all their crypto assets, they have to give an exact distribution of their crypto assets and their wallet addresses to the one asking for the details, impeding their privacy. Once the wallet address is revealed, the asker can continuously keep track of the users’ transaction histories and hence track the user’s current worth at all times, and know about all the transactions the user will do in the future. It is a notable security and privacy issue. The solution to the above problem is a system wherein someone could ask the user whether their net worth is above a particular threshold. The system will return the answer as true or false, but to maintain the integrity of the answer, we will use Zero Knowledge Proof. It will ensure that the total net worth response from all the linked distributed wallets passes the threshold. It will help protect the user’s privacy, and they will no longer have to give an exact distribution of their cryptocurrencies or share their wallet addresses.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Impact of Product Packaging on Buying Decisions of Consumers and Brand Visibility
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Advances in Science and Technology (ICAST)
abstract: This research focuses on understanding the influence of packaging techniques on the customer’s buying decisions and the brand visibility of Fast-Moving Consumer Goods (FMCG) companies. The survey model is adopted to understand the impact of packaging methods on brand visibility. Various elements of packaging techniques like color, material, shape, and image have different levels of influence on the customers before making decisions on their purchase. This research also deep dives into three further factors that are innovation, sustainability, and the superiority of packaging. The results clearly indicate that brand visibility has a more significant impact on customer choices along with packaging parameters. Hence, it can be concluded that there is an association between the impact of packaging on customer purchase patterns and the willingness to spend extra money on superior packaging.

articleTitle: Survey on Resume and Job Profile Matching System
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Advances in Science and Technology (ICAST)
abstract: Finding the correct job profile that matches the candidate's resume and eventually their skillset is a very tedious and time task. The employee as well as the aspirant candidates needs to continuously dig into the information sources to check whether a particular resume is apt for the given job profile and vice versa. Thus, many researchers have contributed to this area. This paper discussed various studies done to give the most up-to-date design methodology for the system that matches job profiles with resumes. For the study, we have considered research work published from year 2018 to 2023. The study shows that recently many researchers have considered such a system as the natural language-based classification problem. Still, the use of similarity measure is the most dominant technique used in this case.

articleTitle: Enhancing Undergraduate Education through Semester-Long Internship Program
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Advances in Science and Technology (ICAST)
abstract: Internship programs have gained prominence as vital components of undergraduate (UG) education, fostering the integration of theoretical knowledge with practical experiences. This paper delves into the significance, design, implementation, and outcomes of semester-long internship program for undergraduate students at K. J. Somaiya College of Engineering. Drawing from existing literature, case studies, and educational theories, we present a comprehensive analysis of the benefits and challenges associated with the program. We highlight their potential to enhance students' academic, personal, and professional development, while also addressing concerns regarding equity, assessment, and faculty involvement. Through this paper, we advocate for the incorporation of well-structured semester-long internship into undergraduate curricula, paving the way for a holistic and experiential learning journey of the UG student.

articleTitle: Blood Donor Classifier Using Hybrid Naïve Bayes Decision Tree (HNBDT)
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Advances in Science and Technology (ICAST)
abstract: Blood donation plays a critical role in healthcare, ensuring a stable supply of blood for medical treatments and emergencies. Efficiently identifying eligible blood donors is paramount to maintaining this supply. The research paper investigates an approach to automate blood donor classification using the Hybrid Naïve Bayes Decision Tree (HNBDT). The study aims to address the growing need for an accurate and efficient donor eligibility assessment system. The prescribed Algorithm i.e., the Hybrid Naïve Bayes Decision Tree Algorithm (HNBDT) gives an accuracy of 75% compared to the traditional classification algorithms of Naïve Bayes and the Decision Tree (DT). The increased accuracy of HNBDT is due to the major step of hybridization.

articleTitle: D-Alarm: An Efficient Driver Drowsiness Detection and Alarming System
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Advances in Science and Technology (ICAST)
abstract: In the coming years, the demand for IoT devices connecting our homes, cities, and industries will grow significantly. We now inhabit a world where interconnected smart devices can be controlled through single commands, fostering an era of automation, particularly in smart homes. IoT is at the forefront of this transformation, with many of these devices relying on machine learning models to decode data and make accurate predictions. However, as the number of connected devices escalates, network congestion becomes a challenge. To address this, incorporating machine learning intelligence into edge devices is essential. Edge computing, which involves processing data closer to its source, reduces latency and enables faster analysis. Consequently, IoT data can be gathered and processed at the edge, reducing the reliance on cloud-based solutions. Yet, deploying machine learning models on small IoT microcontroller units presents memory and computation constraints. This paper introduces a deep learning model for driver engagement recognition in real-time video streams, alongside optimization techniques for deployment on edge devices like Nvidia Jetson. The goal is to facilitate the execution of machine learning models on compact, low-power integrated circuits, addressing this critical bottleneck.

articleTitle: Removal of Organic Matter from Wastewater by Adsorption using Coconut Coir as Adsorbent
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Advances in Science and Technology (ICAST)
abstract: The process of adsorption involves the adhesion of the pollutant (solute) to the solid surface (adsorbent). The purpose of the work is to analyse the mechanism of uptake of organic matter present in wastewater through activated material sorbent derived from various starting materials and coconut coir by varying various parameters. The phenomenon occurs due to van der Waals forces which exist between the molecules. Adsorbents for wastewater treatment included coconut coir and activated carbon. Due to the high porosity of Activated Carbon and Coconut Coir they act as an excellent adsorbent for adsorption. Coconut shells were crushed up to 50mm and heated in a Hot Air Oven at 300°C for about 45 min which removes its moisture and increases its porosity. Effluent used for the project was collected from an industry whose oxygen demand(chemical) was 440 ppm with a pH of 4.36. Batch absorption with different parameters like dosage of adsorbent, concentration and pH were studied. Adsorption increases as adsorbent levels increase. Effluent was treated with adsorbent for 90 min on a mechanical rotary shaker. 4gm of coconut coir and 5 gm of activated carbon was the optimum weight required for 50 ml of effluent for the maximum removal of matter. Percentage removal for 4 gm of coconut coir was 89.09% and 5 gm of activated carbon was 90.90%. 7.1 pH was found out to be suitable for maximum adsorption for both coconut coir and activated carbon. To evaluate adsorption data for activated carbon and coconut coir Langmuir and Freundlich Isotherm models were used.

articleTitle: Text Generation for Hindi
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Advances in Science and Technology (ICAST)
abstract: There is a rapid increase of multimodal data such as texts, images, etc. all over the internet and it is a strenuous task to obtain relevant and vital information from it. Hence, it became a challenging task to process this multimodal data for information retrieval. Thus, language generation model would be helpful for generating precise summary. In the present systems, language generation of textual data is majorly focused, but it’s been observed that images can also contribute to the language generation process. Hence, the proposed model is built on an integrated system to process texts and images of both English and Hindi language data and generates concise summary. Text rank algorithm and Term Frequency-Inverse Document Frequency algorithm is used for text generation for both Hindi and English Language. Additionally, a Neural Image Captioning Model is used to generate captions of images which are then correlated with the textual data for Language Generation. The approach of combining TF-IDF algorithm and Text rank algorithm with Image Captioning model aggregately was effective to generate precise summary while considering the information captured by the images. The text generation model built in this research is language independent and paved a way as a use case in generating text for smart composition of sentences, Question-Answering system on various websites, Search Engine Optimization, etc.

articleTitle: Daily Jobs Now Web Application
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Advances in Science and Technology (ICAST)
abstract: In today’s dynamic work landscape, an individual’s online presence plays a pivotal role in professional success.The study starts by looking at the state of workplace technology today and identifying the rising need for web-based solutions to support both in-office and remote workers. It examines the various difficulties that employees face, including information overload, task management, and bottlenecks in collaboration, which the suggested web application aims to solve.The paper provides a thorough analysis of a web application created to boost employee productivity in today’s diverse workplaces. Through case studies and surveys, it examines the difficulties faced by workers, covers the web application’s development process and key features, and assesses the effect it has on output and job satisfaction. The study’s findings, which provide useful information for Clients looking to empower their workforce in the digital age, show that well-designed web applications can significantly increase worker productivity and collaboration.On this Web application, several issues that affect workers are addressed, including job insecurity, salary disparity, and limited access to crucial resources for career advancement. On This Web Application, employees can communicate, exchange experiences, and access a multitude of resources and assistance.This Web Application aims to provide an extensive and well-structured digital profile for a worker to showcase their skills, qualifications, and accomplishments.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Review of the Artificial Intelligence (AI) shift in E-commerce
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Advances in Science and Technology (ICAST)
abstract: Artificial Intelligence is really taking over the world. Use of AI is everywhere now, the aim of this research paper is to show how artificial intelligence works and how it’s getting involved and solving complex problems in modern world. Specific applications of AI include natural language processing, machine vision, speech recognition, and expert systems. E-Commerce is now adopting this technology to fetch the behavior of their customers based on activity they do in the internet world, like surfing, browsing, as well what they do on social media, and what kind of product they like to see on their feed or show interest in selective products. Many e-commerce giants like Amazon. Flipkart, Myntra, Ajio have already started implementing & observing multiple approaches of AI such as data analysis, deep learning, and pattern recognition to better understand their customers, and provide an enhanced customer experience for each and every one. Personalized shopping using AI involves leveraging customer data and machine learning algorithms to create detailed customer profiles and analyze their preferences and behavior. Artificial intelligence is the next level thing as well as a good use of technology in the modern world. It comes with some drawbacks as well. We have a few things to look at for AI in terms of drawbacks of the same.

articleTitle: An Improved Cache Eviction Strategy: Combining Least Recently Used and Least Frequently Used Policies
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Advances in Science and Technology (ICAST)
abstract: Cache eviction algorithms play a critical role in the performance of a cache system. In our hybrid approach, each item in the cache LRU and LFU has a counter. The counter tracks the frequency of accesses to the item in the cache. When the counter exceeds a certain threshold, the item is moved from the LRU cache to the LFU cache with a time-to-live parameter. The time-to-live parameter specifies the amount of time that the item will remain in the LFU cache before being evicted from the cache altogether. The idea behind this approach is to use the LRU cache to store frequently accessed items that have been accessed recently, while the LFU cache is used to store less frequently accessed items that are still important to keep in the cache. By using the counter to track the frequency of accesses to each item, we can dynamically adjust the placement of items in the cache to optimize cache hit rates and eviction rates. Our simulations show that this hybrid LRU-LFU eviction policy consistently outperforms both LRU and LFU individually in a variety of scenarios, making it a promising solution for optimizing cache performance in various contexts.

articleTitle: Implementation of Blockchain by Gamification
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Advances in Science and Technology (ICAST)
abstract: With the ever-changing demands of technological solutions, blockchain has gained significant importance in terms of security and trusted transactions-based policy. The aim for the paper is to work on blockchain technology and look for a use case which is independent of any external client dependencies for implementation. We researched and found that the game ‘Monopoly’ can be a fit case for demonstration. We have used necessary technologies to fulfil the requirements of the project. This paper is our effort to provide a means to an end making the learning and teaching easier. The tools like Mdb-react-ui-kit and Bootstrap are used to enhance the user experience and dynamics of the Game environment. Styling and confetti effects are integrated to ensure the game styling. Security of data and assets is ensured by usage of Private Blockchain technology i.e., Hyperledger fabric-A permissioned blockchain.

articleTitle: Illness Diagnosis Based on Ayurveda (Vat, Pitta, Kapha Dosha) Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Advances in Science and Technology (ICAST)
abstract: Ayurveda's eight clinical limbs, including pulse analysis, are crucial for early disease diagnosis. The pulse (nadi) is the most crucial, and imbalances in vata, pitta, and kapha doshas can identify illness. This paper aims to analyze the relationship between Nadi Pariksha and pulse signal from a peripheral pulse analyzer. The research aims to develop pulse sensing and analysis methods using modern technologies to support Ayurvedic physicians. Prakruti, a balance in these doshas, influences physiological and psychological traits..

articleTitle: Deep Learning Based Dynamic Signature Analysis for Multiclass Classification
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Advances in Science and Technology (ICAST)
abstract: In the current era of digital authentication, the demand for robust identity verification methods is ever increasing. This paper explores advanced techniques for multiclass signature recognition within the realm of deep learning. The study addresses the intricate challenge of distinguishing diverse signatures across a spectrum of users with machine learning as well as deep learning techniques such as random forest classifiers, MLP, bidirectional GRUs. These methods excel in capturing spatial and temporal patterns within signature data, demonstrating their prowess in recognition. Performance evaluation is conducted using comprehensive metrics like EER, EAR, AUC and ROC curves. These metrics provide insights into the model’s capacity for classification accuracy and discriminative power in multiclass signature recognition. The experiments have been performed on a diverse dataset of 22 users, with each signature exhibiting 144 distinct features such as (x, y) coordinates of position of pen, pen pressure and pen tilt angles. An in-depth analysis of AUC and ROC results for each class showcases the model’s proficiency in user and class differentiation.

articleTitle: Streamlining Educational Assessment: A User-Centric Analysis of an AI-Powered Examination App
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Advances in Science and Technology (ICAST)
abstract: Technology breakthroughs are driving a significant transition in the educational sector. The blending of technology with conventional teaching has increased the efficiency of educational assessment methods. Traditional score management techniques frequently include laborious human grading, which causes feedback delays and inefficiencies in the educational system. Additionally, subjectivity and inconsistent grading practices introduced by humans may increase the bias in evaluations. By allowing students to electronically submit their answer sheets, which are then rigorously analyzed by cutting-edge AI-powered algorithms, this bias can be reduced. The suggested solution in the following study completely transforms conventional score management techniques. The proposed system manages scores and signifies a fundamental shift in schooling. Overall, this system represents a model of effectiveness, openness, and collaboration in the field of education and promises to improve the learning environment for both teachers and students.

articleTitle: Survival prediction in renal cell carcinoma patients using machine learning
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Advances in Science and Technology (ICAST)
abstract: Survival prediction and outcome analysis are essential for any cancer patient. It helps in patient management and treatment plans. Patients with early-stage diagnosis of cancer have a higher survival rate which reduces morbidity and mortality. In this paper, machine learning algorithms are used for survival prediction in clear cell Renal cell Carcinoma (ccRCC). Three slices from the primary tumor and 3 slices from metastasis are selected. The texture features are extracted from these selected slices using a gray level correlation matrix (GLCM), discrete cosine transform (DCT), and discrete wavelet transform (DWT). A patient’s survival is estimated by selecting the most relevant features that are highly correlating within a group. Contrast enhanced computed tomography (CECT) scans of 38 patients are used in this study. K-nearest neighborhood and decision tree classifiers outperform the state-of-the-art machine learning algorithms and provide ‘59.60%’ and ‘57.90%’ classification accuracy for survival prediction, respectively.

articleTitle: An e-learning approach to implement flipped learning pedagogy for physics course
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Advances in Science and Technology (ICAST)
abstract: This paper reports the acceptance level and insight of first year engineering undergraduate learners studying physics. The authors tried to implement an effective approach using e-learning as well as problem based learning as its major instruction for teaching and learning (T&L). The teaching and learning activities based on technology enhanced digital media was done via e-learning which included their assessments in the form of multiple choice based quizzes, rubrics based physics lab journal submission etc. We have also tried to conduct problem based learning in physics using poster making on the given topic, PowerPoint presentation or making screencast video of their presentation. This methodology is an educational approach where the students act as active learners who are guided by facilitator. E- Learning and problem based learning techniques are one of the alternative approaches to the traditional methods of teaching. A set of questionnaire was floated among the students to get their feedback on the new methods of teaching learning involved. Students’ response towards e-learning is also discussed in the paper. The paper presentation activity used in the problem based learning involves the group activity as a flipped classroom teaching medium. Poster presentations are now being used quiet frequently as one of the teaching method. These sessions are beneficial for the students as it promotes learning, serves to be an excellent tool for developing their soft skills. At the same time, it also encourages students to explore the given topic thoroughly and provides opportunities for think-pair-share learning thus, promoting a positive attitude among the students.

articleTitle: Comparative Study on Lung Disease Detection and Classification Techniques using Deep Explainable
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Advances in Science and Technology (ICAST)
abstract: One of the main causes of death and disability worldwide is lung illness, commonly known as a respiratory disease. Pneumonia is one of the most common respiratory diseases, and according to the Johns Hopkins Bloomberg School of Public Health report titled “Lung Cancer is one of the leading cause o death among women and men, with a rate of 5 million cases per year. Pneumonia and Diarrhea Progress Report 2020,” 1.23 million children under the age of five died from pneumonia in 2015. These statistics are from the Forum of International Respiratory Societies.334 million people suffered from asthma disease, different pandemics like Covid19 affected lives of many people. Traditional methods for lung detection included blood tests, sputum tests, chest X-rays, and CT scans. More recently, deep learning models have been used to evaluate automatic analysis and classify regions of chest X-rays into diseased and non-diseased states (for example, TB and Non-TB or malignant or benign tumors)[1]. Deep learning’s “black box” model is explained in detail by explainable AI, which also clarifies the patient’s or examination’s symptoms. In this paper we will exaggerate different deep learning and explainable techniques along with parameter comparison for diagnosis of pulmonary diseases like TB, lung cancer, pneumonia and interstitial lung diseases. This survey aims at getting acquainted with different techniques of detection of lung disease’s using various types of CNN model’s and various types of machine learning classifiers with explainable AI like Grad CAM, Score CAM etc for visualization of disease infected regions Also the study and analysis of different models will help researchers in their studies. Future scope and challenges are also given for further expansion of techniques.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Hand-crafted Feature Descriptors and Deep Learning Architectures for Underwater Coral-reef classification
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Advances in Science and Technology (ICAST)
abstract: Coral reefs are considered to be the most valued ecosystems in the world due to their biodiversity. Coral-reef distribution statistics in the underwater environment impart paramount information regarding the influence of global climate change and contamination levels. Recent developments in the domain of deep learning has led to the use of architectures that help in efficient classification and provides good accuracy compared to traditional methods. In this work, the efficiency of hand-crafted feature descriptors has been compared with that of deep learning architectures like AlexNet, GoogleNet, and ResNet50. Transfer learning methods were utilized in this work rather than training the models from scratch. Experiments were performed on EILAT and RSMAS underwater coral-reef datasets to examine the efficiency of the classification models. Various performance parameters like sensitivity, specificity, precision, F1-score and accuracy are calculated to analyse the performance of the deep learning models. Experimental results suggests that the accuracy obtained with ResNet-50 architecture outperforms other models.

articleTitle: Exploring the implementation of a Blockchain-Based Election Conducting and Management System (BCECMS) to improve election security and transparency
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Advances in Science and Technology (ICAST)
abstract: The revolutionary potential of blockchain technology is investigated in relation to elections in this review research. It looks at the Blockchain-Based Election Conducting and Management System (BCECMS) to improve election security and transparency. After a brief introduction that sets up the situation, the study provides important information on the challenges that traditional voting systems face. The discussion of how blockchain technology will revolutionise voting is then introduced, allowing for a detailed investigation of the BCECMS. The BCECMS section contains an overview of the system as well as details on its fundamental components and functionality, including voting, results verification, voter registration, and authentication. The importance of permanent voter identity, open access to voting records, and encryption for privacy protection are emphasised. It also addresses the administrative and legal matters involved in implementing such cutting-edge technologies. The study acknowledges the challenges and concerns associated with blockchain-based voting systems while providing information on potential roadblocks. Additionally, it looks ahead to potential advancements and directions for future study. In this article, the potential effects of blockchain-based voting systems on the electoral process are summarised. It provides a roadmap for secure and open elections in the age of technology and is a priceless tool for academics, policymakers, and election administrators.

articleTitle: Cryptocurrency Price Prediction using Regression Models on Momentum Indicators
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Advances in Science and Technology (ICAST)
abstract: Cryptocurrencies have enormously gained popularity ever since the launch of Bitcoin in 2009 and are now valued at over a trillion dollars as a whole. A significant number of people actively participate in cryptocurrency trading, to the extent that various goods and services can be acquired through the use of digital currencies like Bitcoin, Ethereum, and others. Nevertheless, the analysis of trends, graphs, and trading strategies involves a considerable level of complexity. Making use of conducted research enables traders to effectively capitalize on trading opportunities. The proposed model uses three momentum indicators which are the Relative Strength Index(RSI), Moving Average Convergence Divergence(MACD), and Average Directional Index(ADX) as features. Each indicator takes as input custom factors that give substantial trend analysis. The values of each indicator are used as features in a variety of machine-learning models that rely on regression to predict the price of cryptocurrencies in the future. The price prediction model is fairly accurate, and it is observed that the gradient boost shows the highest accuracy of the three models with an R-squared value equal to 0.968.

articleTitle: A system for feature extraction and classification of ovarian CT radiology reports
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Advances in Science and Technology (ICAST)
abstract: Electronic Health Records (EHRs) have critical information about the metadata of patients, diagnosis, and severity of the disease, drug dosages, and treatment management plan. EHRs contents are not uniform and are not suitable for decision making process in the initial format. Extracting data and performing analysis of EHRs is very time consuming and expensive. The extracted data may still be noisy, inaccurate, and inconsistent for secondary access. In this paper, a system is proposed that extracts features from CT reports and classifies types and subtypes of cancer using machine learning (ML). ML models are useful for critical decision-making during cancer patient treatment and management. The hybrid feature extraction approach is proposed to select clinically important features from radiology computed tomography (CT) reports. The selected features are further used in the classification of multilevel labeled reports using supervised machine learning (SMI) models. The performance of the classification and feature extraction differ due to variations in data size, imbalance of data, prominence of a particular disease, and variation in report complexity. A total of 984 real world CT radiology reports of 240 ovarian cancer subjects are used. ML models are useful for critical decisio-making during cancer patient treatment and management. Random forest technique outperformed the state-of-the-art ML methods with an accuracy and F1 score of 93.32% and F1 score of 92.84% respectively. The proposed system enables the radiologist to concentrate more on interpreting images rather than structured writing. It also helps oncologists in identifying the type and sub-type and treatment details of the patient without backtracking in consecutive reports.

articleTitle: A Novel Approach on Yoga Posture Identification Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Advances in Science and Technology (ICAST)
abstract: The era of globalization has increased beyond expectations and to fulfil it, every individual has to face many challenges and stressful situations. To keep stress away from us many doctors and health experts suggest suitable yoga, pranayama, diet along with appropriate medicine. In recent times yoga exercise with postures estimation analysis of is followed everywhere because Practicing yoga helps to rise flexibility, improves muscle strength and boost respiratory system. In addition to fostering spiritual growth, yoga has several positive physiological impacts on the body. Yoga strengthens the body and the psyche when practiced regularly. Yoga is not only a physical exercise but also keeps our mental health intact. Yoga helps to maintain self-discipline and self-awareness. But because it is hard to verify the precision of the yoga poses, practitioners won’t gain fully from the exercises. In this research work, we are presenting a scientific analysis related to yoga posture recognition using systematic approach of artificial intelligence and machine learning. The objective is to verify the accuracy of the poses when practicing yoga. We are developing embedded wearable sensor-based device to acquire the time series data from sensors and by using suitable algorithm different postures get recognized. In addition to this we have also studied the benefits of practicing yoga in the improvements of various health parameters.

articleTitle: Online Signature Recognition using Transformer Networks: An Overview
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Advances in Science and Technology (ICAST)
abstract: Online signature verification remains a pivotal component in digital security, ensuring the authenticity of digital transactions and documents. This paper offers a comprehensive overview of prevailing online signature verification techniques, with a particular emphasis on methods employing Deep Learning. RNNs, with their inherent capability to process sequential data, have been instrumental in improving the accuracy and efficiency of signature verification systems. However, as the digital forgery landscape becomes increasingly sophisticated, there is a pressing need to explore advanced neural architectures. In this context, the paper introduces a transformer-based approach for signature verification. Unlike traditional models, transformers, with their self-attention mechanisms, have the potential to capture intricate signature patterns and nuances, offering a promising avenue for future research and application

articleTitle: Enhancing Disaster Response Training through Immersive AR/VR Simulations
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Advances in Science and Technology (ICAST)
abstract: In the realm of disaster response training, traditional methods often fall short in capturing the intricacies and exigencies of real-world disaster scenarios. This paper introduces a pioneering approach that harnesses the immersive potentials of augmented reality (AR) and virtual reality (VR) simulations, shaping the ongoing development of disaster response training. We describe a developing AR/VR training platform that seamlessly combines dynamic scenario development, intelligent virtual agents, and real-time collaboration. By bridging the gap between traditional training approaches and the complex requirements of disaster response, this framework aims to improve training. Emergency responders may actively engage with actual scenarios, make crucial decisions, and coordinate activities in this cutting-edge training environment, all inside a controlled yet realistic catastrophe setting. We laid the groundwork for prospective decision-making, coordination, and reaction capability improvements among emergency responders through early insights and conceptualizations. Real-world case studies are also included to further demonstrate the applicability and validity of our methodology. This study investigates a novel method of disaster response training that combines cutting-edge technology with necessary instruction in the hopes of improving emergency responders abilities and self-assurance.

articleTitle: Shoppers Delight - A web3 integrated E-Commerce application for comparative analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Advances in Science and Technology (ICAST)
abstract: Websites are a great place for marketers to use new technologies to optimize the price of their products. The idea is to increase the conversion rate of users into customers. With the help of our Shoppers Delight, the owner has a better understanding of its rivals and can set variable rates depending on their costs. Paper aims to provide solutions for vendors to sell products at a good deal and save their valuable time, effort, and money. The best deals will be clearly highlighted on the websites. Web3.0 technologies are an emerging set of technologies that have the potential to impact the way we interact with the internet. These technologies focus on creating a user-friendly interface that users could operate at their own pace, with a wider range of functionality in a couple of clicks. Websites will be more interactive, 3D and seamless. They will have built-in payment gateways and offer online services. The web3.0 is a new internet protocol that is decentralized and peer-to-peer.

articleTitle: Advancement of Current Immobilization Techniques for Development of Recent Biosensors
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Advances in Science and Technology (ICAST)
abstract: Biosensors have become effective tools for the sensitive and accurate detection of various analytes, such as pathogens, ions, and biomolecules. Bioactive components must be effectively immobilized on transducer surfaces for biosensors to function correctly. Techniques for immobilization are essential for preserving biosensors’ bioactivity, stability, and overall effectiveness. This review article includes a road map for the future development of biosensors and outlines the advancements made in immobilization techniques. Numerous immobilization methods are established recently to enhance biosensor performance. These techniques include, among others, layer-by-layer assembly, covalent attachment, entrapment, physical adsorption, and self-assembled monolayers. Each approach has unique benefits and drawbacks that affect sensor sensitivity, reaction time, reproducibility, and lifetime. This review highlights these methods’ fundamental ideas and practical uses and how they might advance biosensor technology. Several significant paths are on the roadmap for developing efficient biosensor immobilization methods. First, innovative nanomaterials like graphene, quantum dots, and nanoparticles must be incorporated into immobilization techniques. These nanoparticles increased surface area, higher conductivity, and improved biocompatibility can improve biosensors’ immobilization effectiveness and overall performance. Secondly, advancements in bioconjugation chemistry are required to achieve biomolecule immobilization, which is location-specific and long-lasting. The immobilized biomolecules’ selectivity and sensitivity can be tightly controlled, improving biosensor performance. In conclusion, developing susceptible, focused, and dependable biological sensing platforms is feasible by advancing the discipline and the roadmap to successful immobilization strategies in biosensor development. The potential for biosensors to change numerous industries is still inspiring as nanomaterials, bioconjugation techniques, sensitive interfaces, and standard procedures continue to develop.

articleTitle: Fake Product Detection using Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Advances in Science and Technology (ICAST)
abstract: The spread of counterfeit goods has raised serious concerns among regulators, manufacturers, and consumers with the introduction of e-commerce and digital transactions. The presence of phony goods threatens consumer safety and undermines customer confidence in addition to other negative effects. The effectiveness of using conventional authentication and traceability approaches to handle this problem has been demonstrated to be insufficient. Blockchain, as an immutable and decentralized ledger system, offers a promising platform for ensuring trust and authenticity in supply chains. The system's main features include product registration on the blockchain, the use of unique product identifiers, and the recording of each step of the supply chain trip as an immutable transaction.

articleTitle: Driver Drowsiness Detection Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Advances in Science and Technology (ICAST)
abstract: The ”Driver Drowsiness Detector” system aims to improve road safety by creating a real time system that can detect and alert drivers when they become drowsy or fatigued. Drowsy driving is a hazard that can result in accidents, injuries and even fatalities. This system tackles this issue by combining computer vision techniques, machine learning algorithms and sensor integration to accurately identify signs of driver drowsiness.To detect drowsiness the system takes an approach using recognition eye movement analysis and vehicle control data. It utilizes a camera positioned inside the car to monitor the driver’s face. By tracking features and movements associated with drowsiness such, as eye closure duration, head nods and changes, in facial expression.

articleTitle: Exploring The Integration of Data Analytics and Internet of Things (IoT) for Smart Decision-Making In Various Industries
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Advances in Science and Technology (ICAST)
abstract: The rapid advancements and evolution in the Internet of Things and data analytics have opened up new possibilities for enhancing decision-making processes across a myriad of industries. This review paper explores the integration of data analytics and the IoT and its transformative potential across industries. It highlights the utilization of IoT-generated data through data collection, analytics techniques, and user-friendly deployment for improved decision-making. Through case studies, it demonstrates the benefits and impact of this integration in domains like automotive systems and transportation logistics, emphasizing its potential to revolutionize decision-making processes and drive innovation.

articleTitle: Advance Keylogger – Capturing Keystrokes
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Advances in Science and Technology (ICAST)
abstract: This research explores the development and ethical considerations surrounding an advanced keylogger designed for parental control and employee monitoring. We present the technical aspects of our keylogger, emphasizing its keystroke-capturing features and tailored functionalities for monitoring. Ethical concerns regarding informed consent, privacy, and responsible usage are addressed, along with legal implications in the surveillance landscape. Results from testing and experimentation are presented and analyzed within the context of our research question, highlighting the potential benefits and challenges associated with this technology. This paper stresses the need for a balanced approach, considering technological advancement and ethical responsibility while complying with legal frameworks. It highlights the potential advantages of these tools for enhancing the safety and security of children and organizations in the digital era.

articleTitle: Developing Unsupervised Learning Techniques for Business News Articles
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Advances in Science and Technology (ICAST)
abstract: Business leaders, marketers use business news to inform their day-to-day decision-making processes. This includes creating a business strategy, determining advertising tactics, planning operations, and investing in workforce development. Business news provides a global perspective on current business trends and developments, including tracking mergers and acquisitions and keeping a stakeholders informed. Keeping up with commercial ventures is crucial in today’s fast-paced business world. However, with the abundance of news websites available, it can be a daunting task to sort through the substantial volume of information. This research aims to find new ways to gather relevant news articles by embedding them into vectors through the use of in-depth research methods. The study employs unsupervised learning techniques to form clusters of these embedded vectors, with the goal of developing innovative methods for aggregating relevant news pieces. In the study, related news stories are grouped using clustering algorithms including K-means and agglomerative algorithms, as well as a variety of embedding techniques like Bag-Of-Words, TFIDF, Word2vec, and BERT.

articleTitle: Enhancing Music Data Clustering: An Empirical Analysis for Music Clustering and Scaling Optimization
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Advances in Science and Technology (ICAST)
abstract: This paper presents a deep dive into music recommendation and proposes MCSO (Music Clustering and Scaling Optimizer), a novel method to cluster songs and evaluate these clustered recommendations. Past research has explored different user-based techniques to predict and recommend suitable music. In this paper, songs are clustered based predominantly on their audio features using the MCSO approach. In MCSO, combinations of over 6 different clustering algorithms and 4 scaling techniques were evaluated using metrics such as the Silhouette score, the Calinski-Harabasz(CH) score, and the Davies-Bouldin score. The scores of these three indices indicate that among clustering algorithms, BIRCH, when used along with the Minimum Maximum Scaling technique produces the optimum result. The BIRCH clustering algorithm exhibited superiority over the second-best clustering algorithm (Mini-Batch KMeans) by 15.913% in the Silhouette Score, 8.577% in the Calinski-Harabasz Index, and 29.986% in the Davies-Bouldin Index. Additionally, amongst BIRCH itself, MinMaxScaler demonstrated a performance advantage of 0.264% in the Silhouette Score, 3.447% in the Calinski-Harabasz Index, and 0.816% in Davies-Bouldin Index over MaxAbsScaler and other top-performing Scaling techniques.

articleTitle: Transfer Learning-Based Recommendation System
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Advances in Science and Technology (ICAST)
abstract: E-commerce refers to online business operations carried out electronically. It also includes the buying and selling of intangible items like services and digital goods. Essentially, it pertains to business internet sales. The development of this industry is unquestionable given that over 4.9 billion people now have access to the internet, and it is actively altering the operating business models across all sectors. The recent COVID-19 pandemic has acted as a catalyst in this and created the perception that online transactions and shopping can be secure, producing results in product satisfaction comparable to those of offline shopping. E-commerce is the way of the future and the present for businesses to serve their customers, gather feedback and reviews, and make it simple for customers to buy without having to physically go anywhere. An e-commerce platform cannot be built without user-friendly software programs that facilitate exchanges between customers and businesses. We aim to deliver a software for building an ecommerce website that provides services such as: Product search, reverse image search, product recommendation, sales analytics, and a chatbot for the user experience.

articleTitle: Gesture-Based Computer Control
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Advances in Science and Technology (ICAST)
abstract: This project introduces a groundbreaking Gesture-Based Computer Control System aimed at enhancing digital inclusivity and accessibility for individuals with physical disabilities. Traditional computer interfaces often impose limitations on these users, creating obstacles to their digital engagement. This innovative system revolutionizes their interaction with computers by utilizing intuitive gestures. The core components of this system consist of an Air Mouse, Air Keyboard, and Air Canvas, all designed to provide an enriched computing experience. The Air Mouse enables precise cursor control and selection through natural hand movements, eliminating the need for physical pointing devices. The Air Keyboard translates gestures into text and commands, offering an alternative input method for those with restricted mobility. The Air Canvas empowers users to create digital art and interact with software using intuitive hand gestures, fostering creativity and productivity. By embracing gesture-based interaction, this project aims to empower individuals with physical disabilities, granting them greater control over their digital environment while dismantling traditional accessibility barriers. This innovative system promotes inclusivity and is a huge step towards a more accessible, inclusive and user-friendly computing landscape for everyone.

articleTitle: Analysis of DDoS Attacks using Datamining
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Advances in Science and Technology (ICAST)
abstract: Recent technological advancements have ushered in an era characterized by the continuous generation, processing, and sharing of huge amounts of data globally. This has significantly enhanced communication and connectivity through various devices such as Personal Computers, mobile phones, apps, and websites. With the escalating number of users, the corresponding increase in data production has resulted in a surge in internet traffic, giving rise to numerous challenges. One prominent challenge is the threat of Distributed Denial of Service (DDoS) attacks, wherein malicious actors can disturb the normal flow of traffic to a targeted server, service, or network by inundating it with a deluge of Internet traffic. In this paper a system is proposed that employs data mining techniques to analyze packet header files and identify DDoS attacks, specifically focusing on SYN flood attacks.

articleTitle: Krishi Mitra - Intelligent Crop And Fertilizer Recommender
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Advances in Science and Technology (ICAST)
abstract: Krishi Mitra - Intelligent Crop And Fertilizer Recommender System employs machine learning algorithms to provide personalized crop and fertilizer suggestions based on specific farming conditions, including various environmental parameters such as temperature, humidity, pH, rainfall, crop types, and soil nutrient (N,K,P) concentrations. The proposed research aims to enhance crop recommendations for farmers by predicting the most suitable crops for their unique agricultural settings. To enhance overall prediction accuracy, the crop recommendation model leverages an Ensemble approach, where an ensemble model is trained using Random Forest and XGBoost algorithms, and its performance is compared against that of the Artificial Neural Networks (ANN) algorithm. This comparative analysis allows for the selection of the most accurate model for crop recommendation and fertilizer customization. This approach optimizes crop selection and fertilizer recommendations, potentially leading to increased crop yields and improved farming productivity. The proposed implementation of this system holds the potential in revolutionizing agriculture by offering sustainable recommendations, bridging the gap between farmers and technology, and enhancing agricultural productivity and sustainability.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Survey of Machine Translation Approaches
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Advances in Science and Technology (ICAST)
abstract: The field of machine translation (MT) has advanced over the years, with three major approaches dominating the field: Rule-Based Machine Translation (RBMT), Statistical Machine Translation (SMT), and Neural Machine Translation (NMT). This research paper provides an extensive review of these approaches, including their development, advantages, and disadvantages. Initially, RBMT represented a cutting-edge technology, performing translation using dictionaries and explicit language rules. However, dealing with intricate linguistic patterns was severely hindered by its rigidity and limited scalability, which gave rise to SMT. In order to provide more flexible translations, SMT used statistical models to extract patterns from large multilingual corpora. This method became well-known since it was data-driven, but it still had problems with domain adaptation and a lack of high-quality parallel data. With the introduction of NMT, a breakthrough occurred in the field of translation. NMT uses deep learning techniques including recurrent neural networks and Transformer-based neural networks to produce more meaningful and accurate information. Since NMT is end-to-end, it increases translation efficiency and has no RBMT or SMT limitations, especially for low-resource languages and complex sentence structures. In this paper, we discuss these approaches used by the numerous researchers in this field, and highlight their respective advantages and disadvantages.

articleTitle: Enhancing Hate Speech Detection through Emoji-based Classification using Bi-LSTM and GloVe Embeddings
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Advances in Science and Technology (ICAST)
abstract: The emergence of user-friendly and affordable online networking platforms like YouTube and Instagram have provided people of all ages with a platform to express themselves and share their personal experiences. Regrettably, this has also resulted in surge of harmful and unwarranted statements being made on these platforms, with the aim of damaging someone’s reputation or social status. To combat this, it is crucial for both the government and these platforms to acknowledge and take steps to curb hate speech. However, identifying hate speech automatically can be a daunting task, particularly in tech-savvy countries like India, where non-standard spellings, varied grammatical structures, and code-mixed language with emojis are prevalent. In this study, we delve into the identification of hateful speech within text that incorporates emojis through the implementation of machine learning and deep learning models on code-mixed social media content. Our approach involves analyzing approximately 42,000 tweets that feature both textual and emoji-based features. The results of our recommended approach have been favorable in detecting abusive language in relevant datasets.

articleTitle: Streamlining Clinical Practice Management: An Online Portal Solution for Quality Healthcare Access
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Advances in Science and Technology (ICAST)
abstract: Medical practitioners face challenges in providing high-quality care while increasing revenue, reducing costs and improving efficiency. The work carried out proposes an online portal to streamline clinical practice management, enabling quick appointment bookings and real-time communication between patients and providers. Integrated communication channels, including telemedicine offer improved access to care. The portal benefits both patients and providers, enhancing the patient experience and allowing providers to focus on care delivery. The undertaken research provides an online portal that optimizes workflows and improves patient experience.

articleTitle: Numerical Investigation of Surface Wettability with Textured Surfaces Using Lattice Boltzmann Method
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Advances in Science and Technology (ICAST)
abstract: Surface wettability refers to the capacity of a liquid to adhere to a solid surface. The interplay between the properties of the solid material and the surface tension of the liquid plays a pivotal role in determining the nature of the interaction between the two, forming the basis for this adhesive capability This paper uses a two-dimensional (2D) pseudo-potential multiphase lattice Boltzmann approach with a D2Q9 model to give a numerical evaluation of the wetness of textured surfaces. The solid-fluid interaction parameters (Gads) range from −2.50 to −1.40. To assess the accuracy of current numerical model, a simulation of the equilibrium state of a water droplet on a flat surface is initially considered, considering various interaction parameters. Next, to create the hydrophobic and superhydrophobic surfaces that allow for a larger contact angle, we placed the micropillars with varying heights and spacing on the surface’s bottom wall. Water fills the fluid domain above the pillar height, but air remains in the spaces between the pillars. Water droplets having a radius of 30 lattice units are used to simulate the wettability of surfaces within a 200x200 lattice unit region. The current work demonstrates that, due to the momentum redirection phenomenon, increasing the interaction parameter of textured hydrophobic surfaces significantly reduces the contact area between the solid walls and water droplets while simultaneously increasing the hydrophobic nature of the surface. Analogous occurrences are noted when the micropillar spacing is increased, meaning that this increases the surface’s hydrophobicity.

articleTitle: Revolutionizing Healthcare: Early Disease Detection through Retinal Imaging and AI-Driven Approaches
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Advances in Science and Technology (ICAST)
abstract: Revolutionizing healthcare through advanced AI techniques, retinal imaging is leading the charge in early disease detection and surveillance. Leveraging the retina’s distinct vascular patterns, this approach facilitates non-invasive identification of conditions including diabetic retinopathy, hypertensive retinopathy, retinal emboli, anemia-related changes, and retinopathy linked to chronic kidney disease. At the forefront of this transformation is deep learning-assisted retinal imaging, a potent force reshaping diagnostics. This study thoroughly dissects the methods, outcomes, and transformative potential inherent in this groundbreaking fusion. The creation of a precise Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) algorithm, painstakingly adjusted to detect diseases from retinal images, is a key component of this achievement. The ultimate aim is to replace traditional invasive procedures and blood tests, streamlining diagnostics and minimizing patient discomfort. The investigation delves deep into the intricacies of CNN layers and their training protocols, unveiling the foundational mechanisms driving this approach’s effectiveness. The paper offers a comprehensive snapshot of the synergy between retinal imaging and AI-driven analysis, emphasizing its potential to reshape healthcare diagnostics. As the medical landscape evolves, a future takes shape where non-invasive disease detection becomes the norm. By harnessing retinal images and AI algorithms, healthcare professionals can deliver swift, precise diagnoses, ultimately improving patient outcomes. This analysis underscores the profound impact of this fusion, paving the path to heightened precision, efficiency, and accessibility in disease detection and surveillance.

articleTitle: GaitSynergy: Redefining Gait Analysis with Vision-EMG Convergence for Precise Neuro-Muscular Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Advances in Science and Technology (ICAST)
abstract: Quantitative analysis of gait has significantly contributed to our understanding of the intricate dynamics of human locomotion. Leveraging the integration of computer vision and electromyography (EMG) signals, our study seeks to enhance the understanding of the gait cycle dynamics in real-time. The project involves the simultaneous capture of gait videos through computer vision techniques and the monitoring of muscle activities using EMG signals. By synergizing these two methodologies, we aim to create an efficient and affordable tool for improved patient care and diagnostics. The proposed model incorporates AI-driven computer vision, specifically utilizing the Mediapipe library, to calculate essential gait parameters. Additionally, the integration of a budget-friendly EMG sensor, AD8226, making this gait assessment model more accessible. A user-friendly web app with authentication features is also being developed to facilitate seamless access for trained professionals and ensure data security. This innovative approach not only addresses the current challenges in healthcare accessibility for neuromuscular disorders in India but also offers a comprehensive and affordable solution for gait analysis.

articleTitle: Review of “Speech Emotion Recognition”: A Comprehensive Study
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Advances in Science and Technology (ICAST)
abstract: The review article, “Speech Emotion Recognition: A Comprehensive Study,” starts off by summarizing the significance of speech emotion recognition and highlighting all of the different ways it may be used in fields like healthcare, human-computer interaction, and customer service. It offers a methodical classification of various methodologies and comprises feature extraction techniques, classification algorithms, and datasets utilized in SER. A study of the field’s transition from traditional handmade components to deep learning-based techniques is included, along with an explanation of their implications. This study offers a comprehensive understanding of the state of SER systems today, covering their benefits, limitations, and future implications. For academics, professionals, and decision-makers attempting to comprehend the workings of voice emotion recognition technology, it is a helpful resource.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Different Preprocessing Techniques for Digital Mammograms Towards Breast Cancer Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Advances in Science and Technology (ICAST)
abstract: Breast cancer, finds itself as the most dreaded and commonly found cancer worldwide. The CAD system using mammograms assists radiologists for breast tumor diagnosis in its earlier stages. Preprocessing mammographic images is first action in tumor identification, as it contributes to image quality enhancement, noise reduction, feature extraction, and artifact removal. Precise segmentation of breast and pectoral muscle regions is another step-in preprocessing as the pectoral muscle appears the same bright as cancerous tissue on a mammograph, giving a false positive indication and changing the direction of the medication. The paper’s Prime objective is to offer a comparative study of different pre-preprocessing and pectoral muscle separation methods, for breast cancer detection. During this review, we encountered different noise removal, image enhancement and pectoral muscle removal methods. Adaptive median filtering is most popular method is utilized in removal of noise. Even though various approaches are implemented for the preprocessing of digital mammogram accuracy, precision is not reached at its optimal level. This review article provides merits, demerits and future scope of different preprocessing and segmentation techniques, which will be helpful for readers and future researchers to design and develop novel preprocessing and segmentation techniques which will be beneficial in the accurate detection of cancer.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Algorithms for Cargo Container Space Optimization
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Advances in Science and Technology (ICAST)
abstract: This work delves into optimizing container space utilization in contemporary logistics and warehousing by addressing the intricate challenge of efficiently fitting various tire types into 2D and 3D containers. In our work we have used cutting-edge algorithms such as Next Fit, Best Fit Decreasing, Genetic Algorithm, Dynamic Programming, and Ant Colony Optimization, the study aims to maximize container space utilization while offering insights into tire arrangement and container occupancy percentages. Our evaluation showed significant differences in algorithm performance regarding time and space complexity. Next Fit is simple but can lead to suboptimal space usage. Best Fit Decreasing optimizes space better but demands more computation. Genetic Algorithm and Dynamic Programming are competitive but resource-intensive. Ant Colony Optimization excels in container space optimization with a unique, nature-inspired approach. This study serves as a valuable reference for professionals and researchers tackling complex packing challenges in logistics and warehousing, fostering advancements in efficiency.

articleTitle: A Study to Investigate Total Harmonic Distortion in Electric Railway Power System
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Advances in Science and Technology (ICAST)
abstract: In recent years, harmonic distortion has emerged as a significant issue in electric distribution systems. Many electric utilities have been grappling with problems linked to harmonic distortion within their networks. THD, arising from non-linear loads and equipment can lead to voltage and current waveform distortions within the power supply network, causing power quality issues and potentially affecting the performance of trains and associated equipment.
